jobs.title: Software Engineer II (.NET)
jobs.description:
EBS is a rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial technology company and part of Alarm.com. Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6+ million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. We’re innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more.

The Access Control (AC) team
is a blend of full-stack engineers, leaning backend, who build the platform that businesses rely on to secure and manage physical access to their properties. Our services span the full journey of an access control system — from cloud APIs and event pipelines down to the communication layer that talks directly to panels, card readers, and smart locks in the field. Some examples include enabling multi-site businesses to manage access from a single dashboard, delivering real-time access activity and history to property managers, and keeping thousands of controllers in the field configured, updated, and in sync with the cloud. We’re seeking a Software Engineer II
(Backend-leaning Full-stack) who is passionate about building reliable, scalable systems that bridge cloud software and real-world hardware and wants to see their code open doors — literally — for businesses around the world.

As a Software Engineer II on the Access Control team, you will design, develop, and maintain the backend services that power our access control platform — from cloud APIs and event pipelines down to the systems that communicate with physical controllers and readers in the field. While the role is backend-leaning, you’ll work across the full stack, contributing to our web front end when features call for it. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers who will support your growth as you take on increasing ownership of features and systems.

Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. We are building a new team in Krakow. Our employees work fully from the office with possibility to work remotely occasionally.

Responsibilities

Build and Deliver: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and data models that power our access control platform.
Bridge Cloud and Hardware: Contribute to the device communication layer that connects our cloud platform to access control hardware — panels, readers, and locks — including device configuration, firmware update, and real-time event processing flows.
Contribute Across Layers: Develop features across the full stack, including web front-end features (Ember.js), when projects require it.
Own the Lifecycle: Take part in the entire development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and production monitoring.
Get Hands-On: Work directly with real access control hardware to develop, test, and debug device integrations.
Ensure Quality: Write unit and integration tests, validate features before release, and monitor production performance.
Balance Trade-offs: Exercise good judgment — know when to iterate quickly and when to build for scale, robustness, and maintainability.
Collaborate: Work closely with product managers, hardware/device engineers, and other software teams across time zones.
Grow and Share: Learn from senior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing — and share your own knowledge as the team grows.
Continuous Improvement: Bring your ideas! We want our engineers to collaborate on product development, not blindly build to a spec.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong object-oriented programming skills; experience with C# is a plus.
Experience developing backend services and HTTP APIs (REST or similar).
Experience with database design and development (SQL).
Experience with creating and maintaining unit tests; familiarity with integration testing and CI/CD is a plus.
Familiarity with a modern JavaScript framework such as Ember.js, Angular, or React.
Experience working with hardware, IoT, or device development is a plus.
Good communication skills.

Why Work for Alarm.com?

Make an immediate impact — own projects that directly affect the businesses that rely on our security solutions every day.
Work with real-world IoT devices — see your code in action on the access control panels, readers, and locks we integrate with.
Be empowered — take ownership of features, drive technical decisions, and build best-in-class products.
Work with modern technologies — our stack includes C#, .NET, SQL Server, Kafka, Ember.js, and native mobile applications.
Long-term employment based on a permanent employment contract (CoE).
Attractive benefits package — Medical care, life insurance, sports package, annual budget for professional development ($2,000).

Company Info

Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6 million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. And every day, we're innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more. We're seeking those who are passionate about creating change through technology and who want to make a lasting impact on the world around them.

EBS Sp. z o.o. is a dynamically growing Polish technology company, combining decades of innovation with deep expertise in smart security solutions. We are part of the American corporation Alarm.com, a leading global provider of intelligent security solutions for homes and businesses.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com or ebssmart.com

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
. PANDORA’s Digital & Technology Hub in Warsaw
is a key part of the world’s largest jewellery brand, supporting millions of people in expressing their emotions through meaningful jewellery. As one of our fast-growing global locations, the Warsaw Hub plays a vital role in driving digital innovation, delivering scalable technology solutions and supporting our global transformation journey. Our teams work closely with colleagues across the globe, including our headquarters in Copenhagen, to shape the future of digital in retail and e-commerce.
Behind every great experience at Pandora is a robust digital foundation. Our engineering teams build and connect the systems that power our global ecosystem. You will join a dynamic environment where innovation meets reliability, and every integration is crafted with care. We value creative problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement—ensuring equitable opportunities for all.
We’re proud of our inclusive, people-first culture, guided by our values: We Care, We Dream, We Dare, We Deliver.

Role Summary:

The Engineer is a delivering member of a GOPT (Omni Operations Product Line) product team. You will build and support the integration solutions that keep Pandora's supply chain and distribution systems running, working within the technical direction set by your Lead Engineer and inside the agreed architecture and engineering standards. You will need good communication skills to work with your team, product colleagues and business analysts.
You will help deliver quality automated CI/CD pipelines, from requirements through test and behaviour driven development, whilst maintaining operational stability and high coding standards, together with supporting quality deployments, monitoring of the tech stack and overall production health.
The main outcome for this role is dependable delivery — well-tested, well-documented code shipped with minimal disruption to the business — and steady growth towards owning larger pieces of work independently. You will be part of our engineering chapter and will contribute to a DevSecOps culture towards build and run.

Key accountabilities System design and architecture Contribute to the design of integration solutions using .NET technologies and event-driven architecture, working to the technical approach set by the Lead Engineer and within the agreed architecture blueprint
Work with cross-functional colleagues (product management, architects, business analysts) to understand business requirements and translate them into technical tasks
Raise design questions, risks and unknowns early rather than resolving them alone

Integration development Develop and implement .NET-based integration components under the technical direction of a Senior or Lead Engineer, ensuring correct data flow across platforms, systems and applications
Write automated, reusable, testable and efficient code, applying Pandora engineering standards for performance, security and scalability
Participate actively in pair programming and code review — both submitting your work and reviewing the work of peers
Write and maintain unit and integration tests within the team's automated testing frameworks
Maintain technical documentation for the components you build — integration mappings, API specifications and troubleshooting notes
Identify opportunities to simplify or improve existing integrations and propose them to the team

Deployment and operations support Prepare and execute deployments of your changes into non-production environments, and support production deployments alongside a more senior engineer
Provide post-deployment support and monitoring; join the on-duty engineering roster once onboarded, with a defined escalation path to Senior and Lead Engineers
Investigate and resolve incidents and defects affecting the components you work on, escalating promptly when an issue crosses system boundaries

Security and compliance Apply Pandora's secure coding practices by default — parameterised data access, input validation, no hardcoded secrets, least-privilege service configuration
Ensure changes comply with security standards, privacy regulations and company policies; raise anything unclear with the Lead Engineer or Information Security rather than working around it

4. What is needed to succeed 2+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, or a strong graduate profile with demonstrable project work
Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C#, .NET, JSON
Familiarity with REST APIs, web services and integration concepts; exposure to event-driven architecture and messaging platforms such as Kafka or Solace is an advantage
Practical experience with version control, automated testing and CI/CD tool chains
Exposure to supply chain, warehouse or logistics execution systems is an advantage rather than a requirement — domain knowledge is expected to be built on the job
Understanding of Agile delivery and a willingness to work in a build-and-run team model, including an on-duty rotation
Curiosity, and the willingness to ask for help early and to act on review feedback
English (business fluent)

Our Offer:

- Stable employment based on an employment contract with 3-month probation period- Hybrid work model (onsite from our office on Domaniewska 28 street) - minimum 6 days per month- Free parking for employees regardless of position (reservation required),
- Flexible working hours

Job Description

Emerging technologies such as Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), cloud, artificial intelligence, and APIs, together with strategic trends such as ESG, have the potential to transform our industry. Euroclear aims to leverage these technologies and trends to develop products, services, and capabilities that address market inefficiencies and reinforce its role as a trusted market infrastructure provider.

The Innovation tribe within IT is responsible for delivering these digital capabilities across business lines and entities. To support its continued growth and ambitions, we are strengthening the team with a Test Automation Engineer who will work in a fast-paced, truly Agile environment.

The Test Automation Engineer will contribute to software delivery by designing, developing, and maintaining automated tests, while also supporting manual testing activities when required. The role is key to ensuring high-quality, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with product owners, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear test scenarios and automated test cases.
Design, implement, execute, and maintain automated tests for API and web applications to validate functionality, performance, and user experience.
Support continuous improvement of testing practices, quality processes, and automation coverage within the Agile team.
Identify, report, and follow up on defects, working closely with developers to support timely resolution.

Your Qualifications

3–5 years of professional experience with C#, TypeScript, Java, or another object-oriented programming language.
Solid understanding of semantic HTML and CSS.
Good knowledge of API testing and UI test automation frameworks such as Playwright.
Professional experience using Git in a collaborative software development environment.
Strong understanding of software quality principles and how to improve quality processes.
Demonstrated experience working across the full software development life cycle within an Agile team.
Good knowledge of SQL.

Nice to have

Certification in software testing, such as ISTQB Certified Tester, or another relevant professional certification.
Experience with Microsoft Azure and DevOps practices.
Experience with Angular.
Experience with test-driven development.
Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment practices.
Experience with AI-native development practices, including the use of AI-assisted coding, testing, and automation tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. We're looking for a hands-on Senior Technical Lead to build a B2B eCommerce platform for a leading pharmaceutical brand, and to lead the engineers building it alongside you.

This is a coding role first. You'll spend most of your week in the codebase, setting the technical standard by writing the hardest parts yourself and reviewing everything else. You'll work to the architecture set by our Technical Architect and turn it into working software, leading a distributed engineering team and working alongside WPP's managed service team who run and support the platform in Liferay.

Lead a distributed engineering team day to day, owning technical delivery through the sprint

Break the architecture down into buildable work, and challenge the design where implementation reality says it won't hold
Own the build and release pipeline, environments and branching strategy
Debug and fix the problems nobody else can, across Liferay, integrations and infrastructure
Make sure what you build can be run, monitored and supported by a managed service team at agreed service levels
Support technical service transition, including runbooks, operational acceptance criteria and monitoring requirements
Act as technical escalation for the managed service team on complex incidents and root cause analysis
Own the technical debt backlog in the codebase and get remediation into the sprint, not just onto a list
Work directly with product owners, QA and the client's technical team at working level, in refinement, demos and technical clarification

Strong hands-on Java engineering. You're coding now and you want to stay that way
Proven Liferay DXP development experience. OSGi modules, Service Builder or client extensions, headless and REST APIs, fragments and workflow
Commerce experience, on Liferay Commerce or a comparable platform. Catalogues, pricing, channels, carts and order flow
Solid integration engineering. REST, messaging, enterprise integration patterns and error handling in anger
Confident with relational databases, query performance and data modelling
Practical cloud experience, and CI/CD pipelines you've built and maintained yourself
Experience leading engineers through code review, pairing and technical direction rather than line management
Experience building solutions that are handed into, or run by, a managed service or application support team
Observability, logging, monitoring and alerting treated as part of the build
Clear written and spoken English, and technical documentation other engineers can actually use
Comfortable in a distributed, multi-location team across UK and India

Liferay certification, or contribution to the Liferay community
Experience delivering into validated or regulated environments. GxP, CSV or data residency
Event-driven architecture and streaming platforms
Caching strategies at scale, at Liferay and CDN layer
Elasticsearch or OpenSearch tuning
Prior experience of a blended change and run model

You will collaborate with our UK project team, so we’ll need you to be available until 18:00 PL

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

cooperation ranging from 159 - 206 PLN

We empower your Brains
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.

And we champion Courage

jobs.title: M365 AI Platform Architect
jobs.description:
Job ID: 5931

Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.

We are looking for a M365 AI Platform Architect to join our team Content Management in End User Engineering & Operations service domain. In this role, you will proactively drive the vision, target architecture and technical roadmap for AI and agentic AI. While the primary focus is on Microsoft 365 AI capabilities, the role should also understand how other enterprise AI platforms, such as Gemini, Claude or similar GenAI solutions, may influence Nordea’s broader AI architecture landscape, integration patterns, governance guardrails and technology decisions. You will align architecture decisions with business and IT strategy, define standards and guardrails, evaluate emerging AI technologies and help stakeholders understand trade-offs so that AI enablement is secure, scalable, compliant and strategically aligned.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About Our Team

Content Management in End User Engineering & Operations provides modern digital workplace services across Nordea. We are responsible for governance, compliance processes, platform enablement and operations related to Microsoft 365 services and supporting platforms. Our technology stack is broad and includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, agentic AI governance capabilities, integrations and custom applications for digital workplace. We add value by enabling Executives, Business, IT, Traders and Branches with dependable end-user services required for their daily work.

Our team is international, with colleagues based in Denmark, Finland and Poland. Your future manager is located in Warsaw.

Main responsibilities in this role:

Proactively drive the vision, target architecture and technical roadmap for AI and agentic AI platform enablement across Microsoft 365 and related cloud platforms in alignment with business and IT strategy.
Define technical guardrails for AI capabilities like M365 Copilot, Copilot Agents, Co-work
Design and architect agentic AI solutions and frameworks, including SharePoint Agents, Declarative Agents, Copilot Studio, custom/pro-code agents and Agent 365-enabled scenarios.
Define tenant-level platform controls, admin settings, enablement policies and technical review criteria.
Work with other team on environment strategy, DLP policies, Entra identities and AI governance.
Translate risk, security, privacy and compliance requirements into practical platform architecture and design controls.
Maintain architecture documentation, reference patterns, technical decision records and platform readiness requirements for new Microsoft 365 AI capabilities.
Proactively develop, guide and govern architectural standards, principles, reference patterns and best practices to reduce complexity, manage risk, improve agility and enable business capabilities.
Analyze stakeholder requirements and maintain an overview of the current Microsoft 365 application, integration, identity and infrastructure landscape, including gaps that must be addressed through architecture roadmaps.
Build consensus and commitment among architects, platform teams, governance functions and business stakeholders on architectural trade-offs, target picture and implementation priorities.
Guide and advise stakeholders on architectural issues and implementation choices to ensure solutions are technically sound, supportable and aligned with Nordea standards.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks and tools to support strategic technology decisions and future platform direction.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are a strong AI and Microsoft 365 architect who can combine platform ownership, cloud architecture, security thinking, strategic architecture discipline and product mindset. You enjoy defining scalable guardrails, making technical decisions transparent and helping business and maker teams understand what is possible, allowed and supportable. You can communicate complex concepts in clear and understandable ways, drive consensus across stakeholders and contribute to architecture evolution that reduces complexity, cost and risk while improving agility and business capabilities.

Your background and skills include:

Strong AI, Microsoft 365 and enterprise architecture experience across enterprise-scale environments.
Good understanding of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID and Microsoft 365 admin capabilities.
Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
Awareness of broader enterprise AI platforms such as Gemini, Claude or similar GenAI solutions, including how they may affect enterprise AI architecture, integration, security, governance and platform strategy.
Experience designing and architecting agentic AI solutions, frameworks, reference architectures and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem or Azure Machine Learning.
Have experience with Microsoft Entra Suite, Microsoft Purview, Defender, Power Platform governance or Graph connectors.
Understand Agent 365, Entra Agent ID, agent registry.
Have experience with secure connectors, APIs or knowledge integration
Experience designing secure platform services, enterprise integrations or governance-driven technology enablement models.
Understanding of identity, permissions, Conditional Access, DLP, audit, compliance and operational control patterns.
Ability to create architecture documents, decision frameworks, diagrams, technical roadmaps and implementation guardrails.
Very good communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to drive strategic architecture discussions, facilitate decision-making and build consensus among senior stakeholders, architects and delivery teams.
Experience developing and governing architecture principles, standards, best practices, roadmaps and target-state documentation across one or more architecture domains.

It would be ideal if you also:

Have experience operating platform services in a regulated enterprise environment.
Hold relevant certifications in AI, cloud architecture or enterprise architecture.
Have experience with Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow

This role is open in Łódź, Warsaw, Helsinki. We work in a hybrid model, combining office collaboration with flexible remote work.

What We Offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 15/10/2026. Please note that we will proceed with potential candidates already during the application period.

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

Preliminary CV selection
Phone conversation with the recruiter
Online interview with the hiring leader
Background check

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer I - Poland
jobs.description:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We Also Offer

Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from
A MacBook set up and ready from day one, plus a $500 stipend to design your ideal workspace
Central European Time (CET) hours to support a balanced schedule for our Poland-based team
Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs

Role Overview

As a Staff Software Engineer I, you serve as a technical leader who drives the architecture and development of complex, high-impact software systems across HCP. You apply deep engineering expertise to ambiguous technical challenges, establish scalable solutions and patterns, and influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate projects. You collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business needs into reliable, performant, and maintainable systems. You also elevate engineering practices through technical mentorship, thoughtful design decisions, and continuous evaluation of emerging technologies and approaches.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Our success is their success.

Compensation: 8 200 - 9 700 USD per month (B2B)

What You Do Each Day

Design and implement scalable, high-quality software solutions that address complex business and technical requirements
Lead technical architecture and design decisions for high-impact initiatives across multiple systems
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to define technical requirements, tradeoffs, and implementation approaches
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code that establishes and reinforces engineering best practices
Conduct code and design reviews and provide actionable technical guidance to engineering peers
Troubleshoot complex software issues and drive solutions through root-cause analysis and systematic problem solving
Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability
Develop and maintain technical documentation, architectural patterns, and reusable engineering standards
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend approaches that improve engineering quality, efficiency, or scalability
Mentor and support engineers by sharing technical expertise and strengthening engineering capabilities across the team

Qualifications

5+ years of professional software engineering experience using programming languages and frameworks (i.e. Ruby on Rails, PHP, Python, JavaScript)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
Experience developing web applications and working with content management systems (i.e. WordPress, Strapi, Contentful)
Strong understanding of designing, building, and consuming Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs)
Strong proficiency with version control systems and collaborative development workflows (i.e. Git)
Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, caching mechanisms, and content delivery networks (CDNs)
Experience with performance tuning, memory optimization, and related diagnostic tools
Strong proficiency with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices
Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, and reliability principles
Proven experience driving team efficiency or output quality through the strategic use of AI tools and automation

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Ability to independently develop informed technical perspectives on complex and ambiguous systems
Proactive approach to researching, evaluating, and applying current and emerging technologies
Ability to influence technical direction and collaborate effectively across functions without relying on direct authority
A multi-dimensional background with a breadth of cross-functional interests or depth of specialized mastery
Personal resilience to learn from scratch, and successfully thrive in ambiguity

📌 Our primary technology stack at HCP is Ruby.
To be effective in this role, you’ll need to learn it.
We offer support in the learning process, tailored to your needs and any prior experience with Ruby. This may include mentoring from our experienced engineering team or access to a paid online course that you can complete during working hours as part of your onboarding. The exact form of support will be agreed upon based on insights from your selection process.

Sounds interesting? We're waiting for your resume!

This role is open to candidates in Poland, and the expected salary range for this role is $ + equity. The specific salary for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. jobs.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Technical Lead to build a B2B eCommerce platform for a leading pharmaceutical brand, and to lead the engineers building it alongside you.

This is a coding role first. You'll spend most of your week in the codebase, setting the technical standard by writing the hardest parts yourself and reviewing everything else. You'll work to the architecture set by our Technical Architect and turn it into working software, leading a distributed engineering team and working alongside WPP's managed service team who run and support the platform in Liferay.

What You'll Be Doing

Write production code. Liferay customisation, backend services and integrations, with the complex and high-risk work landing on your keyboard
Lead a distributed engineering team day to day, owning technical delivery through the sprint
Run code review and set the quality bar in the codebase, through standards, testing and pairing rather than documents
Break the architecture down into buildable work, and challenge the design where implementation reality says it won't hold
Own the build and release pipeline, environments and branching strategy
Debug and fix the problems nobody else can, across Liferay, integrations and infrastructure
Make sure what you build can be run, monitored and supported by a managed service team at agreed service levels
Support technical service transition, including runbooks, operational acceptance criteria and monitoring requirements
Act as technical escalation for the managed service team on complex incidents and root cause analysis
Own the technical debt backlog in the codebase and get remediation into the sprint, not just onto a list
Work directly with product owners, QA and the client's technical team at working level, in refinement, demos and technical clarification

What We Want From You

Strong hands-on Java engineering. You're coding now and you want to stay that way
Proven Liferay DXP development experience. OSGi modules, Service Builder or client extensions, headless and REST APIs, fragments and workflow
Commerce experience, on Liferay Commerce or a comparable platform. Catalogues, pricing, channels, carts and order flow
Solid integration engineering. REST, messaging, enterprise integration patterns and error handling in anger
Confident with relational databases, query performance and data modelling
Practical cloud experience, and CI/CD pipelines you've built and maintained yourself
Experience leading engineers through code review, pairing and technical direction rather than line management
Experience building solutions that are handed into, or run by, a managed service or application support team
Observability, logging, monitoring and alerting treated as part of the build
Clear written and spoken English, and technical documentation other engineers can actually use
Comfortable in a distributed, multi-location team across UK and India

If you know some of this, even better

Liferay certification, or contribution to the Liferay community
Experience delivering into validated or regulated environments. GxP, CSV or data residency
Event-driven architecture and streaming platforms
Caching strategies at scale, at Liferay and CDN layer
Elasticsearch or OpenSearch tuning
Prior experience of a blended change and run model

You will collaborate with our UK project team, so we’ll need you to be available until 18:00 PL

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

We offer net hourly rate for B2B
cooperation ranging from 159 - 206 PLN
, dependent on your skills and experience.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.

We empower your Brains
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.

And we champion Courage
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

Learn more about us on our LinkedIn page, visit our YouTube channel and follow us on Instagram WPP Poland.

Please send over your CV in English.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

Är riktigt trygg i C# och .NET

Goda kunskaper inom C# eller annat OOP språk
Positiv, affärsorienterad och lösningsorienterad

Flytande kunskaper i både svenska och engelska

Erfarenhet av Azure
Kunskaper i testautomatisering
Tidigare erfarenhet av eller ett intresse för finansbranschen
React Native, React och TypeScript
Kunskaper inom AI och förmåga att integrera det för att förstärka och optimera plattformen

Vi söker en engagerad och erfaren .net-utvecklare för att delta i spännande projekt inom ett avancerat robotsystem. Som en viktig medlem i vårt dynamiska och agila team kommer du att vara en del av utvecklingen av en redan tekniskt världsledande produkt hos oss på Saab.

Som .net-utvecklare kommer du att spela en central roll i vidareutvecklingen av flera test- och underhållsutrustningar till ett avancerat system för luftförsvar från mark. Systemet genomgår nu en uppgradering och kommer i framtiden att integreras i flera olika lösningar.

Genom nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor förväntas du bidra till teamet med din kompetens och erfarenhet, men du kommer också att få stöd och möjlighet att lära dig och växa in i din roll. Du får även möjligheten att testa olika roller inom vår agila metodik och utvecklingsprocess.

Tillsammans ansvar ni för mjukvaran på olika nivåer, från hårdvarunära till applikation och användargränssnitt. Tjänsten har placeringsort i Karlskoga.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för teknik och mjukvaruutveckling och som trivs i en teamorienterad miljö. Du drivs av problemlösning och motiveras av att hitta effektiva och hållbara lösningar, oavsett vilka verktyg som används.

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud & Data)
jobs.description:
Humblebee is a digital service studio in Sweden. We build digital products with ambitious companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a cloud and data profile to join our product teams, where business, design and tech sit at the same table.

Why this role exists

Software engineering has changed. AI went from a feature you bolt on to a material you build with. That means knowing what to build, getting the data in order, and making the thing survive contact with production and real users.
We’re looking for breadth, and for someone who doesn’t need to be led. You see what needs doing, you say it out loud, and you get it done.

What you’ll be doing

You might be the spearhead: one engineer covering everything a client needs. You might work in a duo with a service designer, where the two of you cover each other’s blind spots. You might sit in a multidisciplinary team with engineers, designers and business-minded colleagues, sometimes ours, sometimes the client’s.

The mix shifts with the assignment. The work could include:

Sitting with clients to understand their business, then turning that into something you can build and ship.
Mapping how work actually gets done, and finding where AI saves real hours instead of looking clever.
Setting up complete AI flows, from data source through model and tooling to the interface people use, and the numbers that prove it pays off.
Building web and product features end to end, from data model to interface.
Designing data flows: getting data out of the systems it’s stuck in, cleaning it, and making it useful.
Building and running AI features that people rely on, such as retrieval, search, agents, recommendations and automated workflows, with evaluation and guardrails in place.
Working with cloud platforms and infrastructure as code so what we build can be deployed, monitored and handed over.
Taking prototypes to production, and being honest about which ones shouldn’t get there.
Using AI tools in your own work, and helping the rest of us get better at it.
Explaining trade-offs, assumptions and limits to people who don’t write code.

Is this you?

You’re a strong engineer first. You’re curious about how a business makes money, not just about the stack. You’d rather ship a small thing that works than a big thing that demos well. AI helps you move fast, and you still own what comes out: it has to hold up a year from now, for whoever picks it up next.

You likely have:

8+ years building and running software in production, ideally client-facing.
Solid experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS, and with infrastructure as code.
Practical experience with data: pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or similar is a plus.
Strong TypeScript, C#, Java or Python. We work mostly in the JavaScript/TypeScript stack, with .NET, C# and Java in some teams, and Python where it fits.
Hands-on experience putting AI into real products: LLM APIs, retrieval, tooling and agents, plus how you know whether it works.
A feel for CI/CD, observability and security, because someone has to run this after we hand it over.
Comfort in the room with clients, including the ones who don’t know what they want yet.
The ability to say no, kindly, when a client asks for the wrong thing.

We like T-shaped people: deep in something, useful across the whole. Nobody knows everything, and we don’t expect you to. We do expect you to feel responsible for the whole, and to be straight about where your edges are.

You are as important as your skills

We hire people as much for their human traits as for their skills. We like good humans around us. We work in the open, in design sprints, development sprints and workshops with clients, so we hire people who are empathetic, kind, patient and generous. We are Humblebee.

Before you apply, read this carefully

To help us find the right fit, we prioritise candidates on these criteria:
Engineering craft.
 You build software that’s secure, fast and still holds up a year later, and you can point to it.
Data and cloud.
 Real experience moving data around and running things in the cloud, not just reading about it.
Business translation.
 You can turn a vague business problem into a clear technical plan, and explain it back in plain language.
Finding the work.
 You spot the inefficiency the client has stopped noticing, and you can size the value of fixing it.
AI in practice.
 You’ve shipped AI features and can tell us what broke, what you measured and what you’d do differently.
Collaboration.
 You like multidisciplinary teams and you make the people around you better.
Growth mindset.
 You share what you learn and help improve how we work.

Tell us about concrete projects. What was the business problem, what did you build, what changed as a result. Outcomes beat tech lists.

Good to know

This position is full-time, based in our Gothenburg office with a hybrid working model (part office, part home). A Swedish work permit is required. We don’t offer relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.
Humblebee is a multi-lingual company, so please write your application in English.

Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

Are you passionate about leveraging modern technologies to revolutionize healthcare? If so, we invite you to join our dynamic and innovative team as a Solution Architect
!

We work in an agile, multinational organization that develops cutting-edge products and services for both public and private sectors across the Nordic countries. Our teams are committed to creating, supporting, and delivering modern solutions used by healthcare and social care professionals throughout the region.

While we've listed several skills and experiences that we believe would be beneficial for this role, please don't be discouraged if you don't tick every box. We're primarily looking for a Lead Software Architect who is eager to learn and grow with us.

In this role you will

Leading Solution Design and Architecture: You will lead architectural decisions that shape the future of our healthcare solutions, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with industry standards
Collaborating with Global Teams and Customers: You will understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions
Engaging with Customer Stakeholders: You will build strong relationships to maintain a clear and predictable product vision
Identifying and Mitigating Risks: You will detect gaps in architecture, security, deployment, and configuration, proposing solutions to minimize risks and enhance system integrity
Mentoring and Coaching Team Members: You will guide them in resolving complex technical issues and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement

We are looking for someone with

Extensive Experience in Software Development and Solution Architecture, with a proven track record in designing and implementing complex software systems
Expertise in Healthcare Standards like FHIR , openEHR, and SMART on FHIR to ensure interoperability and compliance
Visionary Architectural Skills to conceptualize and design holistic solution architectures that meet current and future needs
Knowledge of Cloud and Containerization, including proficiency in public and private cloud platforms and container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
Strong Technical Skills in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, web development, and design patterns

It would be beneficial if you also have

Agile Methodology Proficiency, with experience working in agile environments utilizing methodologies like Scrum or Kanban
Programming Expertise, with excellent coding skills in languages such as C# and experience with frontend frameworks like Angular
DevSecOps Experience, with exposure to integrating security practices into the DevOps process to ensure secure and reliable software delivery

AI knowledge requirement

AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Timo Heikkilä (timo.j.heikkila@tieto.com)

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Key job responsibilities

As a key member of the AWS Europe North Specialist Solutions Architecture team your work will include:

Working closely with our product and field teams and 3rd party model providers, you will help enable new capabilities for our customers to develop and deploy data workloads on AWS infrastructure
Design best in class database infrastructure solutions for all stages of customer and product lifecycles.
You will have the technical depth and business experience to deploy database and data strategies.
Partner with SAs, Sales, Business Development and Service teams to accelerate customer adoption and revenue attainment.
You will also work closely with account teams, research scientists, and product teams to drive model implementations and new solutions.
Thought Leadership - Evangelize and share best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re: Invent, etc.
Act as a technical liaison between customers and the AWS teams to provide customer driven product improvement feedback.
Develop and support an AWS internal community of related subject matter experts.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Hybrid Work

We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near Amazon offices.

jobs.title: Experienced Solution Architect - Cloud, Solna
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of cloud-based API solutions? Join PostNord in Stockholm as an experienced Solution Architect and help build digital services that make a real difference.

At PostNord, technology and social responsibility come together to create digital solutions used by millions of people every day. As an experienced Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping our digital future. We offer a collaborative, forward-looking environment where innovation is encouraged, ideas are valued, and your work has a meaningful impact.

What We Offer You

A strategic role with the opportunity to influence key architectural decisions and the design of future-ready system support.
Work with clear social relevance, contributing to logistics solutions that support people, businesses, and society.
A value-driven workplace that prioritizes wellbeing, flexibility, and sustainable work-life balance.
Strong opportunities for professional development, including sponsorship for cloud certifications.
A hybrid way of working, with access to a newly renovated office in Solna.

What You Will Do With Us

You will join Sender Solutions within Customer Solutions at PostNord Group IT. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Booking API team and other teams across Sender Solutions to define architecture that meets today’s business needs while preparing for tomorrow’s opportunities. Our solutions must meet high expectations for reliability, scalability, and efficiency, supporting both our customers and our long-term technology strategy.

Your role in brief

Shape the design and architecture of digital shipping solutions in close collaboration with the tech lead, product owner, and colleagues in the team.
Spend part of your time contributing hands-on as a system developer in the Booking API team, maintaining deep solution knowledge and staying closely connected to the team’s day-to-day work.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of large-scale solutions and integrations with complex dependencies.
Represent Sender Solutions in cross-area architecture forums, working closely with tech leads across the area.
Support product owners and teams in dialogue with major customers.
Drive innovation and continuous improvement to deliver solutions that meet evolving customer needs.

,

You Will Join a Skilled Team Of Around Ten Developers Working Across Both Back-end And Front-end Development. You Will Work Closely With The Team’s Product Owner, And Your Immediate Manager Will Be Annika Dahlström. The Team Uses Technologies Such As

AWS Microservices / Serverless.
NodeJS / JavaScript / TypeScript / Java
DynamoDB, Postgres, SQS, IAM, OAuth2, Fargate, S3, Elasticsearch, to name a few.
Swagger, Grafana, GitHub, XML/JSON, CI/CD

We are an engaged and ambitious team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. Most of the team works from our office in Solna, with additional developers based in the Philippines. We apply a hybrid working model, with at least 60% of working time spent at the office. For this role, we would welcome a Solution Architect who can be on site more frequently to support close collaboration. We also offer flexible working hours.

More About You

You are an experienced architect with solid expertise in cloud technologies, system development, and API development. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and thrive in a role where you guide, inspire, and support your team. You have an academic degree in IT, or equivalent practical experience, and communicate fluently in both Swedish and English. Experience from the logistics industry is an advantage, as is an understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI, can be applied to create business value.

Above all, you are collaborative, strategic, and customer-focused. You communicate clearly and adapt your message to different audiences and levels of technical understanding.

About Us

We move the Nordics forward. PostNord offers reliable and fast services in parcel, mail and integrated logistics across the Nordics, with a clear target of reaching net-zero emissions by 2040. By connecting people, places, and opportunities, we help our customers grow and provide convenient deliveries for consumers. With our unique Nordic network and climate leadership, we shape the future of e commerce and logistics. In 2025, the Group had around 27,000 employees and sales of SEK 36,2 billion. The Parent Company is a Swedish public limited company with Group headquarters in Solna, Sweden. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at group.postnord.com

Apply

Welcome to submit your application. The selection is ongoing, so please apply as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, certain positions may require a background check. If you progress to a stage where a background check is necessary, you will be informed in advance.

If you have any questions or concerns, please email emina.delkic@postnord.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
Vill du bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar i en produktdomän där stora datamängder, komplexa integrationer och hög transaktionsvolym är en naturlig del av vardagen? Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med stort inflytande över hur framtidens lösningar inom Casino utvecklas. Vi söker en Principal Engineer som drivs av tekniskt hantverk, gillar att lösa svåra problem och vill bidra till att utveckla både system och människor omkring sig.

Casino är ett av ATG:s mest teknikintensiva områden. Här möts moderna backendlösningar, externa spelplattformar, transaktionsflöden, regulatoriska krav och tjänster som behöver fungera dygnet runt. Samtidigt är vi ett område i ständig utveckling där nya produkter, marknadssatsningar och affärsinitiativ kontinuerligt ställer nya krav på våra lösningar.

I rollen får du:

Utveckla och vidareutveckla tjänster och plattformar med höga krav på tillgänglighet, prestanda och skalbarhet.
Ta en ledande roll i tekniska vägval, systemdesign och lösningsarkitektur samtidigt som du fortsätter arbeta hands-on med utveckling.
Arbeta med integrationer, API:er och tjänster som hanterar stora volymer av data och transaktioner.
Samarbeta tätt med produkt, affär, analys, marknad och andra teknikteam för att omsätta behov till robusta lösningar.
Coacha utvecklare, dela med dig av kunskap och bidra till att stärka det tekniska hantverket i teamet.
Vara med och driva tekniska förbättringar, identifiera risker och skapa förutsättningar för långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.

Hos oss får du kombinera tekniskt djup med verksamhetsnära utveckling. Du kommer att ha stor påverkan på hur lösningar designas och byggs, samtidigt som du arbetar nära de tekniska utmaningarna och fortsätter att bidra aktivt i utvecklingen.

Är det här du?

Vi tror att du är en mycket erfaren backendutvecklare som fortfarande älskar att skriva kod och lösa komplexa tekniska problem. Samtidigt har du förmågan att lyfta blicken, se helheten och hjälpa andra att fatta bättre tekniska beslut. Du är en person som andra gärna vänder sig till när systemen blir komplexa, när avvägningar behöver göras eller när nya lösningar ska designas. Inte för att du har den formella rollen som ledare, utan för att du bygger förtroende genom din erfarenhet, ditt samarbete och ditt sätt att dela med dig av kunskap.

Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av:
Java och/eller Kotlin
Spring Boot
AWS eller andra moderna molnplattformar
GraphQL och moderna API-lösningar
Kubernetes och/eller OpenShift
Distribuerade system och integrationsintensiva miljöer
Systemdesign och lösningsdesign
Teknisk ledning, mentoring eller coaching av utvecklare
Att bryta ner komplexa affärsbehov till tekniska lösningar
Att coacha och stötta andra utvecklare i tekniska frågor

Meriterande:
Erfarenhet från spel, fintech, betalningar eller andra regulatoriskt styrda verksamheter.
Erfarenhet av internationella marknader och komplexa integrationslandskap.

We are the game

I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.

Join the game!

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.

Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

jobs.description:
Why Choose TD SYNNEX

TD SYNNEX
is a Fortune 500 IT company
and one of the world's largest technology distributors, with 22,000 employees
operating across more than 100 countries
. We help businesses maximize the value of technology through innovative solutions, services, and partnerships.

About the Role

IBM is a strategic growth vendor for TD SYNNEX across Europe. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the expansion of our IBM portfolio, helping partners accelerate their digital transformation through innovative IBM solutions.

What You'll Do

Lead the end-to-end architecture
of complex IBM software solutions across hybrid, cloud, and on-premises environments.
Translate business objectives and technical requirements into clear solution architectures
and implementation approaches.
Design solutions covering integration, APIs, data flows, identity management, security, resilience, and operational readiness
.
Evaluate architectural options, challenge assumptions, and recommend technically sound and commercially viable solutions.
Identify and mitigate architectural risks, dependencies, and security concerns
early in the sales and design process.
Establish architectural principles, standards, governance processes, and handover documentation to ensure solution quality.
Facilitate architecture workshops and support technical assessments, prototypes, and proof-of-value initiatives.
Collaborate with customer architects, business leaders, IBM specialists, partners, and delivery teams across Europe.
Develop reusable assets, including reference architectures, templates, and best practices
to improve consistency and efficiency across opportunities.

What We're Looking For

Strong experience in solution architecture, technical consulting, or senior pre-sales
within enterprise software environments.
Deep knowledge of IBM software technologies
; IBM certifications are highly desirable.
Solid understanding of enterprise architecture principles
, including integration patterns, APIs, data architecture, security, identity and access management, observability, and lifecycle management.
Experience designing solutions across cloud, multi-cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments
.
Ability to produce clear architecture documentation, diagrams, decision records, and implementation guidance.
Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance customer value, technical quality, cost, and delivery feasibility.
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the confidence to influence and challenge senior business and technical audiences.
Fluent Swedish and English
, both written and spoken; additional European languages are considered an advantage.
Willingness to travel across Europe when required.

What We Offer

Continuous learning and professional development opportunities with clear career progression paths.
Hybrid work
(2 - 3 days at the office per week)
Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, paid leave, retirement plans, and additional local benefits.
Opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies and strategic IBM initiatives across Europe.
Certified Workplace Excellence

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

Elective Benefits:
Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
Grow Your Career:
Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
Elevate Your Personal Well-Being:
Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion:
It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
Make the Most of our Global Organization
: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
Connect with Your Community:
Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.

At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

Vi söker nu en senior .NET-utvecklare som vill bli en del av vårt team som arbetar tillsammans med Naturvårdsverket.
Här får du arbeta långsiktigt med utveckling av digitala tjänster som stödjer Naturvårdsverkets verksamhet och Sveriges miljöarbete. Du blir en del av ett erfaret team från Softronic där vi tillsammans tar ansvar för att säkerställa bästa möjliga kvalité i utvecklingen av Naturvårdsverkets tjänster.

De lösningar vi utvecklar tillsammans med Naturvårdsverket bidrar till att digitalisera och effektivisera viktiga delar av Sveriges miljöarbete.
Du får påverka, på riktigt.
Vi arbetar nära kunden och tar ett stort ansvar för lösningarna vi utvecklar. Som senior utvecklare får du vara med och påverka både tekniska vägval och hur vi arbetar tillsammans.
Du blir en del av ett erfaret team.
Här finns kollegor att diskutera lösningar med, lära av och dela kunskap med. Vi tror på att utvecklas tillsammans.

Och ja, vi vet att livet är mer än jobb. Därför erbjuder vi ett tryggt anställningspaket med kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och flexibla lösningar för balans i vardagen.

Arbeta med systemdesign, arkitektur och implementation i Microsofts teknikstack.
Utveckla och vidareutveckla e-tjänster och andra digitala lösningar för Naturvårdsverket.
Vara delaktig i tekniska vägval och bidra med din erfarenhet i teamet.
Arbeta nära både kund och kollegor i ett agilt team.
Dela kunskap och stötta andra utvecklare

Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och Microsofts teknikstack.
Erfarenhet av agila utvecklingsmiljöer.
Ett självgående och strukturerat arbetssätt.
Förmåga att ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar och samtidigt bidra till teamets gemensamma leverans.
Ett stort teknikintresse och en nyfikenhet på nya tekniker, verktyg och arbetssätt. Du håller dig gärna uppdaterad inom ditt område.

God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift.

E-tjänster.
Offentlig sektor.
Större eller komplexa systemmiljöer.
Erfarenhet av JavaScript/react.

Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med teknik i ett sammanhang där systemen har ett tydligt syfte. Naturvårdsverket har en central roll i Sveriges miljöarbete och digitalisering är en viktig del i att göra information, processer och tjänster mer effektiva och tillgängliga.

Leda workshops, kravinsamling och verksamhetsanalyser för att identifiera hur AI-agenter, Copilot-lösningar och generativ AI kan skapa affärsvärde och stödja verksamhetsprocesser.

Identifiera och definiera användningsfall för AI-agenter samt omsätta affärsbehov till lösningsarkitekturer med fokus på automatisering, beslutsstöd, självbetjäning och produktivitet.
Ansvara för den tekniska lösningsdesignen av AI-agenter, inklusive orkestrering mellan agenter, integrationsmönster, datakällor, kunskapsbaser, RAG-lösningar (Retrieval Augmented Generation), agentinstruktioner och eskaleringsmekanismer.
Utforma säkra och skalbara lösningar med fokus på governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering (Microsoft Entra ID), dataskydd, regelefterlevnad och ansvarsfull AI.
Leda implementation och kvalitetssäkring av lösningar genom nära samarbete med utvecklare, verksamhetsexperter och lösningsarkitekter inom Dynamics 365 och Power Platform.
Driva innovation och rådgivning kring nya möjligheter inom agentbaserad AI, Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar.
Stötta kunder i deras AI-resa genom utbildning, förändringsledning, arkitekturrådgivning och etablering av best practices för AI och agentutveckling.

Vi söker dig med:

Mycket goda kunskaper i konfigurering av Dynamics 365 CE/CRM och/eller Power Platform-verktygen, exempelvis Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse och Power BI.
2-4 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och/eller Power Platform, exempelvis som konsult, systemansvarig eller superuser.
Praktisk erfarenhet av att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla AI-agenter och Copilot-lösningar med hjälp av Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar. Förståelse för agentarkitektur, generativ AI, orkestrering, integrationsmönster och ansvarsfull AI.
God verksamhetsförståelse inom områden som försäljning, kundservice, marknadsföring eller ekonomi.
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

Vi är ett ledande nordiskt IT-bolag som stärker våra kunders IT-förmåga i en allt mer komplex digital värld. Experience with CI/CD pipelines
