Description

If you are looking for an opportunity to build innovative cloud-native solutions, work with AI/ML technologies, and make a direct impact on customers migrating to AWS, this might be the role for you.

Our team is responsible for the development of DMS Schema Conversion — the cloud-based service within AWS Database Migration Service that automatically assesses and converts database schemas, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and other database objects from commercial databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Sybase) to AWS-native targets such as Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora.

DMS Schema Conversion is an instrument for automatic conversion of database metadata to a format compatible with the target database or service located in the AWS cloud. We are actively integrating Generative AI capabilities to automate time-intensive conversion tasks, reducing manual effort for customers and accelerating their migration journey.

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you will tackle challenging distributed systems problems, design and build features that serve customers at scale across 29+ AWS regions, and contribute to the next generation of AI-powered migration tooling.

AWS DMS team is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain cloud-based solutions that accelerate database migrations to AWS
Build and enhance schema conversion engines that transform database objects, stored procedures, and application code across multiple source/target conversion pairs
Integrate Generative AI capabilities to automate complex code conversion tasks that previously required manual intervention
Architect and implement scalable microservices deployed across 29+ AWS regions
Collaborate closely with database engineers, front-end engineers, and product managers to deliver high-quality features
Analyze existing database architectures to determine optimal migration and conversion strategies
Mentor other engineers, conduct design reviews, and contribute to engineering best practices
Research and identify new opportunities for AWS to innovate on behalf of our customers
Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence initiatives

A day in the life

You will design, develop, and deliver features that enable customers to seamlessly migrate their database workloads to AWS.

You will drive architectural decisions, solve complex problems with innovative approaches, and deliver with limited guidance while raising the technical bar for the entire team.

You will work on complex challenges driving architectural decisions, code transformation, distributed systems, and Generative AI integration — all while operating at AWS scale.

Our team is a passionate, highly-motivated group of specialists across a variety of technologies working in a fast-paced environment.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Aurora Control Plane, Aurora Control Plane
jobs.description:
Description

Come join the growing RDS Aurora Serverless Control Plane team, innovating on behalf of our customers on a service that:

Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud native databases for our customers freeing them from traditional database operations
Guarantees best-in-class availability and failover capabilities to sustain the world’s most demanding workloads
Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of a database cluster from creation to operation to scale-up, scale-out and fail-over

Amazon Aurora Serverless Control Plane does all this and more. Amazon Aurora is a cloud-native relational database which combines the scalability and performance of the best NoSQL databases paired with full compatibility to the most popular relational open source databases - MySQL and PostgreSQL. Amazon Aurora can store petabytes of customer data and can handle peaks of millions of queries per second. As one of the fastest-growing services at the core of the AWS Cloud and also one of the largest managed database services in our business, your engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses depend on the scale and performance of Amazon Aurora and its control plane to support their mission-critical workloads. We continue to believe it is Day 1 for the Amazon Aurora business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to Amazon Aurora.

As a Software Development Manager in this role, you will own a core part of the Control Plane charter, responsible for Aurora Serverless v2 and its wide array of enterprise features.

You will work in a highly collaborative, diverse and engaging environment that attracts talent and provides ample opportunities to grow and learn. You will have the freedom to shape how the team works and what mechanisms and processes you want to establish to achieve the teams and organizations goals and deliver results to our customers. This role gives you the opportunity to have an impact on the future of Aurora and its future growth.

In this role you provide technical direction and guidance to the team you are working with. Our engineers know that building a control plane to manage large scale cloud native databases is fun and challenging. It is not just any distributed system. It is a system orchestrating a distributed storage engine operating with petabyte scale data sets, real-time node failure detection mechanisms, multi-datacenter and cross-continent replication. You will coach junior and intermediate members of the team to become established contributors to our service by providing interesting and aspirational projects and mentoring them to successfully complete them. You will collaborate with senior engineers to work on large and complex features that have impact across different teams in the organization and high value for our customers.

You will also work directly with our customers to gather feedback and understand their use-cases. Together with the Aurora leadership this will help you to shape a vision for the team and define and align roadmap and deliveries with our product management. You will lead the delivery of new features both customer-facing and improving operational and technical efficiency of the solution. You will have an impact on our new offerings by taking advantage of your knowledge of industry trends and engineering tradeoffs and your ability to listen and understand the customer. You will be a thoughtful steward of existing systems, appropriately challenging assumptions and driving change when necessary to allow us to scale for growth.

This is a hands-on position in which you will be asked to show ownership. If you are technically knowledgeable and a good collaborator and communicator that can lead with empathy for our customers and engineers, then this is for you. We don’t need you to be an expert in databases. You will have a chance to learn on the go. We rather appreciate curiosity and craftsmanship over knowledge in specific technologies. At the same time you will benefit from interacting with many of the talented people within AWS and they will help you improve and expand your management and technical skills on a daily basis.

Aurora is part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services

Key job responsibilities

The role encompasses people, product and project management together with technical leadership. As a manager within the team, you will have opportunities to set the teams’ roadmap, and to work closely with support teams, senior engineers and other managers within the Amazon Web Services (AWS) organization.
The position involves manager on-call responsibilities, one weekend every 3 months. We don’t like getting paged, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant and that our alarms are well calibrated. When we do get paged, we work together to first mitigate and then resolve the root cause so we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.
Grow and foster talent from Junior to Senior devs on a daily basis
Establish mechanisms to efficiently run the team and help prioritize and balance the backlog
Work with PM and other engineering teams on roadmap strategy and prioritization
Share updates to the leadership team on the teams deliverables
Review designs and help shape the teams design documents
Manage and drive the operational ownership of the team

About The Team

Team is focused on customer dev experience and often operates across the org, closely working with Aurora Serverless, Aurora Storage, Aurora Platform teams.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Experience in engineering team management

Experience in leading the definition and development of multi tier web services
Experience partnering with product and program management teams

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Making life accessible

iLOQ is an international company headquartered in Finland that offers intelligent locking systems and total access management solutions. We provide secure and efficient access to buildings and facilities. Our mission is to make everyday life easier with a diverse range of safe and sustainable products for individual buildings, large real estate complexes and critical infrastructure sites.

We reinvented the lock. iLOQ's self-powered digital locking and mobile access solutions work without batteries or mechanical keys, something nobody thought was possible until we did it. But the lock is only half of the story.

Behind every iLOQ lock is iLOQ 5 Series+. iLOQ 5 Series + is our modern, cloud-based, AI-enabled software platform which powers access management for buildings and large real estate complexes across the world. Locks, keys, apps and cloud services are all working as one system: this is where hardware innovation meets serious software engineering. Scalable backend services, security-critical design and a platform that keeps evolving with new AI-driven capabilities.

We are now looking for a Senior Backend Developer
to join our Software organization in Oulu. You will design, develop and maintain the secure, reliable and scalable backend services at the core of iLOQ 5 Series+. This is a role for an experienced software professional who enjoys solving complex problems, takes ownership beyond writing code and wants to influence both technical solutions and the way software is developed.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will work as part of a cross-functional software team and contribute throughout the software lifecycle.

You will:
Design, develop, test and maintain reliable, scalable backend services and APIs for our cloud-based platform
Take end-to-end ownership of services from design and implementation to release, monitoring and continuous improvement
Translate functional and non-functional requirements into practical technical solutions
Explore and apply AI-assisted development tools in a secure and responsible way
Review code and develop automated tests, supporting high standards for security, quality and maintainability, and contributing to efficient CI/CD practices
Investigate and resolve complex technical issues
Contribute to the modernization and continuous development of our software architecture
Collaborating with Product Owners, Software Architects, Test Engineers and other stakeholders, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

What you'll bring

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:
Relevant degree (Bachelor or Master)
Several years of professional experience in backend software development, including designing and implementing APIs and backend services
Strong skills in C# and .NET or comparable backend technologies
Experience with cloud technologies, preferably AWS, and a solid understanding of microservice architectures and distributed systems
Experience working with relational databases and data-driven applications
Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD and modern software development practices
An understanding of software security, maintainability and operational reliability
The ability to analyze complex problems and turn them into clear, sustainable solutions
A proactive and collaborative working style with strong communication skills, including professional written and spoken English

We consider experience in the following areas an advantage:
AWS services and cloud-native application development
Event-driven architectures and asynchronous communication
Service monitoring, logging and observability
Secure software development or access management solutions
High-availability or business-critical systems
Working with software solutions that interact with physical products or devices

What you'll get

You will build products that end up in buildings all over the world and ease the everyday lives of our customers. You will have real responsibility and freedom to operate without big corporation bureaucracy. We ensure you’ll have room to grow professionally in a fast-growing international company.

We offer you a workplace within a collaborative and forward-thinking company culture, friendly and skilled colleagues, proper onboarding, and a solid benefits package: bonus program, full lunch benefit, extensive occupational health care with an annual dental check, life insurance, plus regular team and company events.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and all employees are treated with respect. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and join us in promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Are you the person we are looking for?

We are expecting your application by October 14th at the latest. Please note that we might be reviewing candidates and conducting interviews during the application process and filling the position as soon as the right person has been found.

Could iLOQ hold the key to your next success story? Come and find out.

jobs.title: Software Development Consultant (early career)
jobs.description:
Are you looking to grow not only as a software developer, but also as a trusted advisor? At Columbia Road, we're looking for talented developers to help businesses grow while you grow your career. If you've already gained some hands-on experience in professional software development and are eager to grow into a skilled consultant in a low-hierarchy, supportive environment, we would love to hear from you. Let’s find your Road!

TLDR

Role: Software Developer (Associate Consultant or Consultant)
Focus: Help businesses grow by building and improving digital sales channels and systems for our clients.
Environment: Low-hierarchy, supportive, community-led, with an emphasis on transparency and trust.
Team: Varying teams built around each individual client’s need. Cross-competence collaboration.
Ideal Candidate: A couple years of professional web development (full-stack) experience, eager to learn and make an impact. The position is also suitable for someone finishing their studies. Fluent in English and Finnish.
Location: Helsinki or Tampere, no visa sponsorships offered.
Salary & benefits: Monthly gross salary 3000-4500€, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. Extensive benefits package, including e.g. comprehensive healthcare insurance, allowance for sports/massage/commuting and compensation for doing social good & open source projects to name a few.

Who we are

Columbia Road is the go-to consulting partner for businesses that want to sell better. Excelling in both commercial operations and scalable technology, we build seamless and effective customer journeys for measurable impact. In each of our projects, we focus on generating more revenue and more customers for our clients, working in cross-competence teams made up of the brightest minds in digital commerce.

As a community-led company, we believe in giving a lot of responsibility and freedom to our employees. Instead of line managers and red tape, we offer the tools and resources to all Roadies to make the best possible decisions for their own job and for our community. We offer you a diverse and inclusive workplace, and your fellow Roadies will ensure that you’ll feel comfortable from day one.

The job & what you’d be working on

As a software developer, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern digital sales channels. You’ll get to work together with other Columbia Road consultants in a cross-competence team, building and growing new digital businesses for our customers in various fields of business. This means you may collaborate daily with designers, digital marketers, strategy consultants, data & AI specialists as well as our clients' stakeholders and team. You will be supported in your learning by peers in both development and other domains, and you’ll have the ability to create real impact in our clients’ businesses.

Your motivation comes from the results and impact your solution creates, rather than the technical beauty of the code. For us, technology is a tool to create business impact for our clients, and we are agnostic in choosing whichever tools best solve the challenge. This can mean widely used programming languages and frameworks, but also different CRM, CMS and ecommerce solutions that we customise and integrate to our clients’ other systems. We have listed some examples further below.

If you're looking for a workplace where you get a lot of responsibility and where you get to learn new things fast from more experienced peers, you'll find it here. You will get to grow with us, nurture your own ambitions and learn new skills within digital sales.

This position is a great fit for you if

You are a student in the final year of your studies, or have graduated within the past couple of years.
You have already gained professional work experience related to software development. For example, you may have worked part time in a professional setting during your studies.
You have a good understanding of the basic principles of both backend and frontend software development.
You’re agnostic in your tech-approach and are open to using a wide array of languages, frameworks, CRM and CMS systems and ecommerce platforms, selecting the tools that best match our clients’ needs.
Some of the most common languages we come across in our work are JavaScript, Typescript, PHP, Java and C#. We hope you are comfortable with more than one of these.
Other technologies seen as an advantage include: Clojure, Scala, Python, Go as well as any experience working with CMS, CRM and ecommerce platforms.
You are self-driven, proactive and want to continuously learn new things.
You understand the basics of digitalisation and you approach problems in an analytical manner.
You would love to work with challenging client cases supported by a diverse community of digital sales professionals.
You are comfortable communicating matters related to your own work and you enjoy working with other people in an agile environment – it’s not a problem for you to present your own ideas to a small group of people from time to time, for example in a workshop.
You have a “get things done” attitude towards your work.
You live (or plan to move) within commuting distance of Helsinki or Tampere and are open to working on-site according to client needs.
You are fluent in English and Finnish.

Recruitment process

Our recruitment process typically involves 2-3 interviews where we learn about your skills and what motivates you. You'll discover more about Columbia Road and meet various Roadies along the way. After our discussions, we'll reach out to your chosen references.
This is a permanent, full-time position with a flexible start date from August 2026. We hope to hear from you soon!

Benefits

A monthly gross salary of 3000-4500 euros, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. In addition, we offer extensive benefits:
A community-led organisation with a high level of autonomy
A diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
Option to buy stocks of the company through the common employee share program
Recurring training and learning sessions to support your professional growth
Regular mentoring with a Roadie of your own choosing - or several!
Offices in downtown Helsinki (with gym and pool) and Tampere
A wide selection of quality tools to use for your work (laptop, phone etc.)
Extensive health care services, including dental and mental health
Insurance for travel and free-time
Lunch benefit
Phone subscription benefit
Weekly breakfasts and healthy daily refreshments
Flexible sports, culture, commuting and massage benefit
Recurring Roadie-ideated events and activities
Childcare services when your child falls ill
A possibility to book the office for private events during the weekends
Compensation for working on open source or social programs in your free time

We help companies sell better by building seamless digital solutions and running concrete growth activities. Find your Road with us by exploring open jobs or Connecting with us!

jobs.title: M365 AI Platform Architect
jobs.description:
Job ID: 5931

Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.

We are looking for a M365 AI Platform Architect to join our team Content Management in End User Engineering & Operations service domain. In this role, you will proactively drive the vision, target architecture and technical roadmap for AI and agentic AI. While the primary focus is on Microsoft 365 AI capabilities, the role should also understand how other enterprise AI platforms, such as Gemini, Claude or similar GenAI solutions, may influence Nordea’s broader AI architecture landscape, integration patterns, governance guardrails and technology decisions. You will align architecture decisions with business and IT strategy, define standards and guardrails, evaluate emerging AI technologies and help stakeholders understand trade-offs so that AI enablement is secure, scalable, compliant and strategically aligned.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About Our Team

Content Management in End User Engineering & Operations provides modern digital workplace services across Nordea. We are responsible for governance, compliance processes, platform enablement and operations related to Microsoft 365 services and supporting platforms. Our technology stack is broad and includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, agentic AI governance capabilities, integrations and custom applications for digital workplace. We add value by enabling Executives, Business, IT, Traders and Branches with dependable end-user services required for their daily work.

Our team is international, with colleagues based in Denmark, Finland and Poland. Your future manager is located in Warsaw.

Main responsibilities in this role:

Proactively drive the vision, target architecture and technical roadmap for AI and agentic AI platform enablement across Microsoft 365 and related cloud platforms in alignment with business and IT strategy.
Define technical guardrails for AI capabilities like M365 Copilot, Copilot Agents, Co-work
Design and architect agentic AI solutions and frameworks, including SharePoint Agents, Declarative Agents, Copilot Studio, custom/pro-code agents and Agent 365-enabled scenarios.
Define tenant-level platform controls, admin settings, enablement policies and technical review criteria.
Work with other team on environment strategy, DLP policies, Entra identities and AI governance.
Translate risk, security, privacy and compliance requirements into practical platform architecture and design controls.
Maintain architecture documentation, reference patterns, technical decision records and platform readiness requirements for new Microsoft 365 AI capabilities.
Proactively develop, guide and govern architectural standards, principles, reference patterns and best practices to reduce complexity, manage risk, improve agility and enable business capabilities.
Analyze stakeholder requirements and maintain an overview of the current Microsoft 365 application, integration, identity and infrastructure landscape, including gaps that must be addressed through architecture roadmaps.
Build consensus and commitment among architects, platform teams, governance functions and business stakeholders on architectural trade-offs, target picture and implementation priorities.
Guide and advise stakeholders on architectural issues and implementation choices to ensure solutions are technically sound, supportable and aligned with Nordea standards.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks and tools to support strategic technology decisions and future platform direction.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are a strong AI and Microsoft 365 architect who can combine platform ownership, cloud architecture, security thinking, strategic architecture discipline and product mindset. You enjoy defining scalable guardrails, making technical decisions transparent and helping business and maker teams understand what is possible, allowed and supportable. You can communicate complex concepts in clear and understandable ways, drive consensus across stakeholders and contribute to architecture evolution that reduces complexity, cost and risk while improving agility and business capabilities.

Your background and skills include:

Strong AI, Microsoft 365 and enterprise architecture experience across enterprise-scale environments.
Good understanding of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID and Microsoft 365 admin capabilities.
Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
Awareness of broader enterprise AI platforms such as Gemini, Claude or similar GenAI solutions, including how they may affect enterprise AI architecture, integration, security, governance and platform strategy.
Experience designing and architecting agentic AI solutions, frameworks, reference architectures and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem or Azure Machine Learning.
Have experience with Microsoft Entra Suite, Microsoft Purview, Defender, Power Platform governance or Graph connectors.
Understand Agent 365, Entra Agent ID, agent registry.
Have experience with secure connectors, APIs or knowledge integration
Experience designing secure platform services, enterprise integrations or governance-driven technology enablement models.
Understanding of identity, permissions, Conditional Access, DLP, audit, compliance and operational control patterns.
Ability to create architecture documents, decision frameworks, diagrams, technical roadmaps and implementation guardrails.
Very good communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to drive strategic architecture discussions, facilitate decision-making and build consensus among senior stakeholders, architects and delivery teams.
Experience developing and governing architecture principles, standards, best practices, roadmaps and target-state documentation across one or more architecture domains.

It would be ideal if you also:

Have experience operating platform services in a regulated enterprise environment.
Hold relevant certifications in AI, cloud architecture or enterprise architecture.
Have experience with Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow

This role is open in Łódź, Warsaw, Helsinki. We work in a hybrid model, combining office collaboration with flexible remote work.

What We Offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 15/10/2026. Please note that we will proceed with potential candidates already during the application period.

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

Preliminary CV selection
Phone conversation with the recruiter
Online interview with the hiring leader
Background check

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.

jobs.description:
Join us, be part of more.

We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that’s energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels, whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently – we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it and mend it.

About your team:

At Centrica Energy, our mission is to move it.

We’re energy movers by nature. We’re a global renewable energy trading company which helps move energy from source to use – powering businesses, homes, and societies as they transition to a new sustainable energy future. If the idea of working to create a sustainable energy future also moves you, we may very well be the right place for you.

Technology is central to how we move energy from source to use. As a Software Engineer, you will help build and evolve the platforms that support our renewable trading business while contributing to a major effort to bring multiple systems together into a single, long-term technology foundation. Working alongside skilled engineers and business experts, you will have the opportunity to influence both the solutions we build and the direction we take next.

About The Role

We are bringing together several platforms that have supported different parts of our business over many years. As we create a more unified technology landscape, we are investing in the teams that will build, evolve, and maintain these systems for the future. This creates an exciting opportunity for experienced developers to influence both the direction of our technology and the way we work together as engineering teams.

Depending on your skills, experience, and interests, you will either join an existing team where you can quickly contribute and learn from colleagues with deep domain expertise or become part of a team focused on shaping the next generation of our platforms. We carefully match new colleagues to the environment where they are most likely to succeed, supported by a structured onboarding programme, a dedicated buddy, and experienced colleagues who will help you build domain knowledge from day one.

As part of this role, you will:

Lead the design, development, and enhancement of backend services and APIs using .NET C#.
Drive architectural decisions that ensure our solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
Build and enhance desktop applications using WPF while integrating systems through modern Web APIs.
Develop resilient cloud-native solutions using AWS, Kubernetes, messaging technologies, and modern database platforms.
Mentor fellow engineers and contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews, testing practices, and continuous improvement.

About You

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and turning ideas into reliable, scalable solutions. You thrive in collaborative environments where people challenge each other, share knowledge, and work together towards a common goal. While strong technical skills are important, we're equally interested in your curiosity, judgement, and ability to help others succeed.

We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:

Significant experience developing enterprise applications using .NET C#.
Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including cloud technologies, system design, and DevOps.
Proven experience designing distributed systems and making sound architectural decisions.
A passion for building maintainable, well-tested software with long-term sustainability in mind.
The ability to partner effectively with business stakeholders, alongside experience with technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Datadog, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL.

Previous experience within energy trading is beneficial but not essential. Strong engineering capability, technical leadership, and a growth mindset matter far more than industry background.

About Centrica Energy

We are a leading energy trading and optimisation business, helping move energy from source to use across global markets. We trade power, gas, LNG, and environmental products, connecting producers, suppliers, and customers while helping make energy systems more flexible, resilient, and sustainable. We are Energy Movers by Nature, driven by our purpose of energising a greener, fairer future.

From eight offices across Europe, Asia, and North America, our teams combine market expertise, data, technology, and trading capabilities to help balance supply and demand, manage risk, and support the transition towards a more sustainable energy future. We are also one of Europe's largest renewable asset managers, with substantial renewable and flexible generation capacity under management.

Joining us means becoming part of an ambitious, international organisation where technology is central to everything we do. Together, we are building solutions that help power businesses, homes, and societies while creating the energy systems of tomorrow.

Why should you apply?

We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.

https://www.morethanacareer.energy/centricaenergy

If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

jobs.title: Experienced Software Developer – Team Box Collab
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help modernize a product area at the heart of construction projects.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for an experienced software developer to join our Box Collab team.

You will build software in our File Management product (Box) that enables communication and collaboration across construction stakeholders—for example, file comments, sharing, versioning, and review. This domain is widely used and deeply integrated across the Dalux product suite, so reliability, performance, and strong technical design are essential. In Box Collab, we foster an engaging, enjoyable work environment where people take ownership and accountability for outcomes. You’ll join a young, skilled team with strong opportunities to influence both product evolution and architectural direction.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Within Box Collab, there is a particular focus on strengthening and evolving the technical foundation of the product while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of Box Collab.
Improving the structure of an established codebase and reducing technical debt
Helping evolve boundaries and modularity within the application
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas, technologies, and development practices into the team when they create real value

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

The Box Collab team is already experimenting with how these tools can improve its day-to-day development work.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in that development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue evolving your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Box Collab is a full-stack product area primarily built with:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
MSSQL
Elasticsearch

Our wider platform runs on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

What would make you a particularly strong match?

We are looking for an experienced software developer with strong technical fundamentals and the ability to influence the software around you.

For this particular team, we would especially value:

Str ong professional experience with C# and .NET
Strong DB management experience, including indexing strategies and query performance optimization.
Experience improving or modernizing established software systems
An understanding of Domain-Driven Design, modular architecture, or similar approaches to structuring complex applications
Experience mentoring or providing technical sparring to other developers
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

You do not need to match every point.

Technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to make an established product better are more important than having worked with exactly the same technologies or architectural patterns before.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to improve an established product and architecture
A healthy work-life balance, with a strong focus on a sustainable work week and no overwork culture.
Clear opportunities for professional and career growth.
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping evolve an established product and architecture, we would like to hear from you.

We recruit continuously as Dalux grows.

Join our Pizza & Beer event

Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

What do you know about protecting sensitive data? What about fine-grained access control (FGAC) on Big Data? Or attribute-based access control (ABAC) and context based authorization? What about catching bad actors that are abusing Amazon services? Or attacks that could potentially lead to a widespread data breach? Do you know how to generate activity-based intelligence (ABI) through anomaly detection?

In Security Products we build Access Policy Management systems to enable all Amazon teams to apply FGAC to their sensitive data. We build products that apply context based authorization to solve the problem of over-permissioning. We apply Machine Learning Techniques in our Monitored Access (MA) abuse detection program to preemptively detect and mitigate internal and external malicious actors. We do this to protect Amazon customer, seller, vendor and employee information across from constantly changing abuse actor behaviors and patterns.

In our newly created organization we have a rare opportunity to engage with multiple Amazon organizations and groups of experienced tech leaders to build products with impact at an impressive scale (hundreds of thousands of services).

We are looking for enthusiastic Software Development Engineers with strong analytical and problem solving skills, who will participate in full development cycle for mission critical systems. You will work with leading-edge technologies and tools, on innovative and sophisticated features, collaborate with your team and its leadership to drive key engineering and business decisions that will enhance the Amazon’s security posture. You will contribute to all parts of the software development and deployment lifecycle, including design, implementation, documentation, testing and operations.

Key job responsibilities

Your work focuses on delivering software features and improvements to major portions of your team’s software. This is not just new software but often includes refactoring and deprecation work.
You work on difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks. You bring clarity to problems and identify simple designs for solutions.
You design software solutions to enable new features or improve software. You may still require guidance from your team’s leadership to ensure your designs are in alignment with your team’s long-term architectural strategy.
You are a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment and maintenance of the team's software.
You are active in the code review process on your team, providing meaningful feedback to others, including those who are more senior.
You document what your team’s software does; how it is constructed, tested, and operated; how secure it is; and how it fits into the bigger picture. When new teammates join, you actively train them in these points.
Your work positively impacts the software quality, customer experience, and maintainability of your team’s product(s). You are starting to balance customer requirements with team requirements.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or other technical degree or related experience
Experience in computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis)
Computer Science fundamentals in algorithm design, problem solving, and complexity analysis;
Proficiency in at least one programming language such as C, C++, C#, Java or others;

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building large-scale multi-tiered distributed systems.
Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations;
Exposure to agile software development methodologies.
Have previous experience in gathering business information and transform it in technical requirements. - Experience with secure systems and architecting applications that deal with sensitive information

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a team which has been announced as Top Employer for the third consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for a second year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the first time!

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams

Join our continuously growing team, which employs over 2.600 professionals in Greece, to experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, and Thessaloniki and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

We are currently seeking highly motivated persons to work as Software Engineers for our IT Consulting, a leading provider of Technology services to large corporate clients of all industries. As a member of our team:

Skills And Attributes For Success 

You will have a significant technical contribution to large-scale implementation projects
You will be given the opportunity to work and take responsibility in challenging engagements in Greece and abroad
Your ability to learn and apply advanced Technology solutions, will give you the opportunity to grow professionally and participate in the design and deployment of leading-edge technologies.

To qualify for the role, you must have

A Bachelor’s degree in one of the fields of Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field
Team playing capabilities but also independent spirit
Self-motivation to learn and contribute with your own ideas - showcase the feasibility and benefits with proof of concept and documentation of innovative solutions
Effective verbal and written communication skills
Passion for learning and adapting to new technologies

Ideally, you’ll also have

Basic understanding of one or more object-oriented programming languages (C#, Python, Java, etc)
Familiarity with data structure and algorithms
Knowledge of version control systems, preferably Git
Basic knowledge or keen interest in BPM tools and low-code/no-code platforms

What We Look For  

What’s most important is that you’re dedicated to working with your colleagues as part of a high-performing team. You’ll need to demonstrate enthusiasm, high motivation, and passion to develop fast in a multinational working environment. You’ll need to thrive in picking up new skills and talents as you go, so natural curiosity, a lot of questions and the

confidence to speak up when you see something that could be improved are essential. If you’ve got the right combination of technical knowledge and communication skills, this role is for you.  

What We Offer

Competitive remuneration package: You’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Depending on your experience, our comprehensive rewards package includes benefits that suit your needs including cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health insurance scheme, life insurance, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.
Flexible working arrangements: We operate under a hybrid working model, which is defined based on both your own preferences and team’s needs, and we enjoy our summers with short Fridays.
Personalized learning experience and career development: We provide free and unlimited access to educational platforms and EY Badges, support certifications, and provide coaching and feedback, as a part of our Leadership & Development process, all of which can lead to a meaningful impact and success as defined by you.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
International Experience: Become part of international projects and work along multicultural teams, through our global network.
Above all, you will be working in one of the most recognized employers in Greece, as we have been awarded the Top Employers, Great Place to Work and Best Workplaces for Women awards for 2024.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build.

Apply now.

jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Web Services Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Clinical ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) to join our team in Europe. In this role, you'll work directly with pharmaceutical and life sciences customers, including senior technology and business leaders, to understand their business objectives and translate them into innovative cloud and AI solutions that drive meaningful impact in pharmaceutical innovation.

As a PCA, you'll be responsible for creating and leading solution designs to address customer business outcomes (CBO) in the pharmaceutical domain. Operating as the conduit between ProServe Account Executives and our Shared Delivery Teams (SDT), you'll ensure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and optimized to maximize CBOs. You'll lead cloud modernization and AI transformation initiatives, designing scalable AWS solutions that address complex clinical development challenges including clinical trial management, clinical data operations, regulatory submissions, and study lifecycle optimization from protocol design through database lock. Your experience in designing technical solutions within the pharmaceutical sector will equip you to architect complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet specific customer needs, translating technical concepts into business value. Your success will be linked to impacting SOW signings and successful solution implementations that achieve CBOs while exceeding customer satisfaction (CSAT) expectations.

As a trusted technical advisor, you'll provide guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and agentic AI applications specific to pharma. You'll collaborate with expert teams including our Gen AI Innovation Center, Industry Sales, and Product teams to bring leading-edge innovation to customers. As a technical SME, you'll share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable tools such as demos, accelerators, and white papers.

Key job responsibilities

Design scalable, secure AWS solutions that deliver measurable customer business outcomes across HCLS development lifecycle.

Provide technical guidance during sales and implementation phases, focusing on pharmaceutical domain challenges including clinical data management, regulatory submissions (eCTD), study conduct optimization, and GxP compliance.

Partner with customers on industry trends and emerging technologies, particularly agentic AI applications in clinical trial automation, clinical data standardization (CDISC SDTM/ADaM), electronic data capture (EDC), and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).

Collaborate with Account Executives and Delivery Teams to ensure successful solution implementation.

Work with AWS experts and external partners to accelerate innovation.

Share knowledge through coaching, demos, accelerators, and technical documentation.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of cloud architecture, designing and implementing cloud solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience.
4+ years of deep technical experience in designing, solutioning, and building data platforms, AI/ML and /or GenAI solutions to achieve customer business outcomes
Experience managing and delivering large-scale enterprise IT projects, including hands-on experience, across Data, AI/ML, Application modernizations, or GenAI
Experience in presenting technical solutions to customer stakeholders and executive, including ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value propositions and strategic roadmaps that align cloud modernization initiatives with clinical development transformation objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting enterprise-scale clinical/commercial data platforms with proficiency in multi-agent orchestration frameworks, clinical data integration patterns (API-based, batch ETL, real-time streaming), and cloud-native data lake/lakehouse architectures, demonstrating ability to articulate how agentic AI transforms clinical operations through intelligent automation of study planning, site activation, patient recruitment optimization, clinical monitoring, and regulatory submission workflows.
Achieved AWS Professional level certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, and AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty) preferred.
Deep understanding of AWS services across compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies.
Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR).
Expertise in performance optimization and cost management for cloud environments.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences as part of pre-sales motion.

jobs.title: Senior ProServe Cloud Architect, Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS), AWSI Sales
jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Web Services Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Clinical ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) to join our team in Europe. In this role, you'll work directly with pharmaceutical and life sciences customers, including senior technology and business leaders, to understand their business objectives and translate them into innovative cloud and AI solutions that drive meaningful impact in pharmaceutical innovation.

As a PCA, you'll be responsible for creating and leading solution designs to address customer business outcomes (CBO) in the pharmaceutical domain. Operating as the conduit between ProServe Account Executives and our Shared Delivery Teams (SDT), you'll ensure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and optimized to maximize CBOs. You'll lead cloud modernization and AI transformation initiatives, designing scalable AWS solutions that address complex clinical development challenges including clinical trial management, clinical data operations, regulatory submissions, and study lifecycle optimization from protocol design through database lock. Your experience in designing technical solutions within the pharmaceutical sector will equip you to architect complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet specific customer needs, translating technical concepts into business value. Your success will be linked to impacting SOW signings and successful solution implementations that achieve CBOs while exceeding customer satisfaction (CSAT) expectations.

As a trusted technical advisor, you'll provide guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and agentic AI applications specific to pharma. You'll collaborate with expert teams including our Gen AI Innovation Center, Industry Sales, and Product teams to bring leading-edge innovation to customers. As a technical SME, you'll share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable tools such as demos, accelerators, and white papers.

Key job responsibilities

Design scalable, secure AWS solutions that deliver measurable customer business outcomes across HCLS development lifecycle.

Provide technical guidance during sales and implementation phases, focusing on pharmaceutical domain challenges including clinical data management, regulatory submissions (eCTD), study conduct optimization, and GxP compliance.

Partner with customers on industry trends and emerging technologies, particularly agentic AI applications in clinical trial automation, clinical data standardization (CDISC SDTM/ADaM), electronic data capture (EDC), and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).

Collaborate with Account Executives and Delivery Teams to ensure successful solution implementation.

Work with AWS experts and external partners to accelerate innovation.

Share knowledge through coaching, demos, accelerators, and technical documentation.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of cloud architecture, designing and implementing cloud solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience.
4+ years of deep technical experience in designing, solutioning, and building data platforms, AI/ML and /or GenAI solutions to achieve customer business outcomes
Experience managing and delivering large-scale enterprise IT projects, including hands-on experience, across Data, AI/ML, Application modernizations, or GenAI
Experience in presenting technical solutions to customer stakeholders and executive, including ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value propositions and strategic roadmaps that align cloud modernization initiatives with clinical development transformation objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting enterprise-scale clinical/commercial data platforms with proficiency in multi-agent orchestration frameworks, clinical data integration patterns (API-based, batch ETL, real-time streaming), and cloud-native data lake/lakehouse architectures, demonstrating ability to articulate how agentic AI transforms clinical operations through intelligent automation of study planning, site activation, patient recruitment optimization, clinical monitoring, and regulatory submission workflows.
Achieved AWS Professional level certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, and AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty) preferred.
Deep understanding of AWS services across compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies.
Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR).
Expertise in performance optimization and cost management for cloud environments.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences as part of pre-sales motion.
