jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Pivotal is a leading full-service Contract Research Organization (CRO) in Europe, delivering clinical research excellence across global pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors. We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Technology Services team and help build, evolve, and scale the platforms that power clinical trials — from electronic Trial Master Files to patient data capture systems.
This is not a typical corporate dev job. You will work on a GxP-validated clinical platform (Danah) serving real clinical studies, using modern AI-augmented development workflows. Our current stack is React + Vite on the frontend and .NET Core on the backend, but what matters most is your engineering fundamentals and your ability to learn fast with AI. We use Claude Code, Cursor, and multi-model AI tooling as part of our daily engineering practice — not as experiments, but as core productivity multipliers. If you are passionate about building meaningful software, working at the intersection of technology and medical science, and leveraging AI to move faster, this role is for you.
WHY PIVOTAL

Impact that matters.
Your code directly supports clinical trials that bring new treatments to patients worldwide.
AI-first engineering culture.
We build with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and custom AI skills — AI isn't a buzzword here, it's how we ship.
Growth by design.
We invest in our people: permanent mentoring, training budget, conference attendance, and international project exposure.
Diversity of thought.
A diverse, multicultural team across Europe where different backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Design, develop, and deliver features across our React + Vite frontend and .NET Core backend, following Agile (Scrum) ceremonies tracked in Azure DevOps.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery, generate tests, review code, and automate repetitive tasks.
Own the full delivery lifecycle: estimation, development, code review, testing, CI/CD deployment, and production support.
Write and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, E2E) and ensure code quality through peer reviews and static analysis.
Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, Clinical Data Science, and IT teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and deployment automation on Azure.
Participate in architecture decisions, technical debt reduction, and continuous improvement of development best practices.
Support smooth delivery
— take part in capacity planning, share progress updates, and help unblock technical or process issues for the team. Expect this to be around 20% of your time.

Own the initiatives to improve the SDLC with agents.

REQUIREMENTS

6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong frontend experience with a modern framework (React, Vue, Angular, or similar). Our stack is React + Vite + TypeScript + Redux + Material UI — but if you're strong in another framework and willing to learn with AI, that works for us.
Solid backend experience with a typed language (.NET Core/C#, Java/Spring, Go, or similar). Our backend is .NET Core — same principle applies: fundamentals matter more than exact stack match.
Hands-on experience with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or equivalent).
Proficiency with Git and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).
Experience being a scrum master (owner of the SDLC process, metrics, team and delivery).
Experience with Agile methodologies.
Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) — we expect you to leverage AI daily to learn, code faster, and solve problems.
Delivery ownership mindset — you see features through from design to production.
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
Fluent English (written and spoken). Spanish is a plus.

NICE TO HAVE

Direct experience with our specific stack: React + Vite + TypeScript, .NET Core / C#, SQL Server, Azure DevOps.
Experience building or consuming MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations or AI agent workflows.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, custom AI skills/commands, or multi-model orchestration.
Experience with Python scripting for automation, data processing, or tooling.
Knowledge of cloud architecture on Azure (App Services, Azure SQL, Azure DevOps Pipelines).

SKILLS & MINDSET

Problem-solver who thrives under time and resource pressure with strong attention to detail.
Clear communicator — can explain technical concepts to clinical and business stakeholders.
Self-directed and autonomous, comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Curious about AI and new technologies — willing to experiment, learn, and teach others.
Empathetic team player who builds strong working relationships across departments.

WHAT YOU GET

Tools:
AI tooling budget — licenses for Claude, Cursor, and the AI tools you need to do your best work.
Growth:
Ongoing mentoring, training programs, and support for conference attendance.
Flexibility:
Flexible hybrid work model with a modern office in La Florida, Madrid.
Innovation:
Work on R&D innovation projects (CDTI-funded) alongside your core product responsibilities.
Global reach:
International exposure working with sponsors and partners across Europe, the US, and beyond.

COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

At Pivotal, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to the success of our team. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all candidates, regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

jobs.title: Global OT Application Developer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Developer
builds, maintains, tests and stabilises application components and use cases for industrial environments. The role converts approved requirements, designs and standards into reliable software, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards that can be reused across applications and sites.

The Application Developer works closely with Application Engineers throughout implementation, integration, testing and stabilisation, must understand the operational and technical context in which the solution will run, and remains involved in resolving defects and technical issues. It is not an isolated coding position.

Assigned scope:

Configuration and development of use cases within Global OT applications.
Development and maintenance of standard interfaces between Global OT applications.
Implementation of improvements to ensure correct performance of Global OT applications and interfaces.
Writing and maintaining technical documentation, release notes and other documentation required for proper software governance.

Primary emphasis:

Features that are stable, maintainable and suitable for reuse across applications or sites.
Code and configurations for use cases and interfaces that follow agreed versioning and delivery practices.
Documented components that Application Engineers can integrate, deploy and support.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Build and maintain application components:

Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.
Build and maintain within application domains such as IIoT, MES, SCADA, historians and maintenance systems.
Develop database structures and application interfaces in accordance with the approved design and relevant application practices.
Maintain existing applications and application components and adapt them when approved requirements or standards change.

Test and stabilise:

Take responsibility for the technical quality of the developments and configurations.
Create and execute developer-level tests and support broader functional and integration testing.
Identify, diagnose and correct defects discovered during implementation, testing and stabilisation.
Verify that the code deliverables meet the defined requirements and behave reliably in the target application environment.
Support Application Engineers during integration and deployment when code, configuration or component-level troubleshooting is required.

Reuse, standards and maintainability:

Ensure that development can be governed, maintained and reused beyond a single isolated requirement.
Use reusable logics, UX/UI and features where appropriate.
Follow agreed coding, configuration, naming and documentation standards,
Consider performance, reliability and maintainability when implementing application requirements.
Document code, configurations, dependencies and technical behaviour clearly enough for integration and support.

Controlled delivery and versioning:

Develop within the agreed versioning, review and release process.
Use Git or the agreed source-control platform for versioning and collaboration.
Follow the applicable CI/CD, code-review, testing and release practices
Maintain traceability between approved requirements, implemented changes and delivered versions.
Contribute to the correction and stabilisation of released components when development changes are required.

Collaboration across the application lifecycle:

Work with the Application Owner on approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Work with Application Engineers on technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs.
Clarify functional and technical requirements with the relevant business, engineering and architecture contributors.
Provide transparent estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status to the relevant delivery lead or Scrum Master.
Participate in defect resolution and technical discussions with vendors or system integrators when the developed components are involved.

Application-specific requirements:

SQL and application database development.
Programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning and collaborative development practices.
Implementation, testing, defect correction and feature stabilisation.
CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation covering code, configurations, interfaces and delivered components.
Contribution across IIoT applications and use cases (including platforms such as Ignition), MES applications, historian and industrial-data applications, and maintenance applications, depending on the assigned application background.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Advanced: SQL and application database development, including database structures and application interfaces.
Advanced: programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Proficient: industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning, CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle requirements under IEC 62443-4-1.
Working knowledge of application domains such as IIoT (including platforms such as Ignition), MES, historians and maintenance systems.

Behavioral Competencies:

Structured, pragmatic and quality-oriented, with strong ownership of the technical quality of own deliverables.
Constructive challenge of requirements, designs and technical solutions where quality or maintainability is at risk.
Clear cross-functional communication of estimates, risks, dependencies and delivery status across engineering, business and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in software, computer science, automation, electrical or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience developing and maintaining software components for industrial or manufacturing applications such as IIoT, MES, historians or maintenance systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated ownership of complex application components across multiple applications or sites.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany.
Home-based or hybrid working, including collaboration with nearshore and distributed delivery teams.
Occasional travel to manufacturing sites where development support is required.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Global OT Application Developer is accountable for:

Choosing detailed implementation approaches within approved requirements, architecture and standards.
Identifying technical risks and proposing improvements to components and delivery practices.
Raising concerns about potential future issues — technical debt, scalability, maintainability or obsolescence — to the Application Owner and architecture contributors before they affect operations.
Rejecting code or components that do not meet agreed quality and versioning practices.
Supporting integration, deployment and troubleshooting when development expertise is required.
The role does not own the application roadmap, backlog priorities or acceptance decisions, plant connectivity, site readiness, commissioning or operational support, and does not define platform architecture or approve material deviations from global standards; nor does it operate as an isolated programmer without testing, stabilisation and engineering collaboration.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Application Engineers: technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs; day-to-day collaboration throughout implementation and stabilisation.
Delivery lead / Scrum Master: estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status.
Business, engineering and architecture contributors: clarification of functional and technical requirements.
Vendors and system integrators: defect resolution and technical discussions where the developed components are involved.
Nearshore / distributed delivery teams: shared requirements, standards, testing, versioning and documentation practices; dotted-line collaboration with Application Engineers regardless of location.

jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany, plus a senior regional position in the north-eastern United States.
Home-based or hybrid working with regular domestic and international travel to manufacturing sites.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Application Engineer:

Together with the Project Managers, defines implementation and configuration approaches within approved standards.
Stops or rejects a technical deployment when readiness or acceptance criteria are not met.
Recommends fixes, improvements and standard changes based on operational evidence.
Escalates architecture, security, scope and vendor-performance risks.
The role does not own application strategy, roadmap, backlog or commercial vendor decisions, does not act only as a software developer without integration, testing, support and site responsibilities, does not replace the plant's operational ownership or bypass agreed OT governance, and does not approve material deviations from global standards without the relevant owner or authority.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: priorities, scope, standards, acceptance and escalation of commercial or roadmap matters.
Plant operations and local OT teams: site readiness, deployment activities, onboarding, training, support and operational handover.
Developers, delivery leads and Scrum Masters: build activities, defect resolution, planning and release execution.

Business and functional stakeholders (production, quality, maintenance, supply chain): technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions affecting plant operations.

, an English multinational company with a strong presence across Europe, dedicated to the development of projects, deployments, and implementation of IT services, is seeking an AI Automation & Integration Specialist

Main Mission
The AI Automation & Integration Specialist designs, develops, tests, deploys, secures and operates production-grade automations and integrations that connect business processes, enterprise applications, cloud services, data platforms and AI capabilities. The role is a hands-on senior engineering position within SCC Spain’s AI delivery capability, translating solution architectures and business requirements into resilient APIs, event-driven services, automated workflows and reusable integration components across Microsoft Azure and AWS. A core objective is to convert manual, fragmented or repetitive activities into secure, observable and reusable automated processes that deliver measurable operational outcomes. Automation Development & Intelligent Process Orchestration

Measure automation outcomes including transaction completion, processing time, failure rate, manual effort avoided, rework and operational cost.
Define exception paths, audit trails, manual recovery procedures and operational controls for business-critical automations.
Combine deterministic workflow logic with AI capabilities such as classification, extraction, summarisation, routing, decision support and agent tool execution.
Automate interactions with Microsoft 365 and enterprise platforms using Microsoft Graph, APIs, webhooks, events, queues and secure workload identities.
Build reusable connectors, custom connectors, workflow templates, automation libraries and common services that reduce delivery time across customer projects.
Implement scheduled, event-triggered, short-running, long-running and human-in-the-loop workflows, including state management, approvals, timeouts, escalation, compensation and recovery logic.
Design, develop, test, deploy and operate end-to-end automations using Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Logic Apps, Durable Functions, Step Functions, Power Automate and code-based orchestration where appropriate.
Analyse business and operational processes to identify automation opportunities, define automation boundaries and translate requirements into maintainable technical workflows.

Cloud-native Integration & Automation Engineering
Design and implement API-first, event-driven and asynchronous integration solutions using Azure Functions or AWS Lambda, Event Grid or EventBridge, Service Bus or SQS/SNS, and workflow orchestration services such as Logic Apps, Durable Functions or Step Functions.
Build reusable automation components, connectors and integration services using C#, Python, TypeScript or PowerShell, applying appropriate software engineering standards.
Integrate enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, data services and AI endpoints through REST, GraphQL, webhooks, messaging and event streaming patterns.
Modernise legacy point-to-point integrations into loosely coupled, scalable and maintainable cloud-native patterns.
Assess and implement synchronous versus asynchronous patterns, delivery semantics, ordering, idempotency, deduplication, dead-letter handling and eventual consistency.

API Management & Enterprise Integration
Design, publish and govern APIs using Azure API Management and AWS API Gateway, including policies, authentication, authorisation, throttling, quotas, versioning, transformations, caching, lifecycle management and developer onboarding.
Create and maintain API contracts and documentation using OpenAPI specifications, consistent error models and backward-compatible versioning practices.
Integrate with Microsoft 365 services through Microsoft Graph, including appropriate permissions, consent models, webhook subscriptions, change notifications and throttling-aware implementations.
Collaborate with architects to define reusable integration reference architectures, standards and guardrails for customer delivery teams.

Identity, Security & Secrets Management
Implement workload identity and zero-trust patterns using Managed Identities, AWS IAM roles, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, avoiding embedded credentials wherever possible.
Protect credentials, certificates, keys and connection details using Azure Key Vault or AWS Secrets Manager, including secure rotation and access-control practices.
Apply least privilege, managed service-to-service authentication, network controls, encryption and secure API exposure throughout the integration lifecycle.
Contribute to threat modelling, security reviews and remediation of integration components in collaboration with Cyber Security and Cloud teams.

AI-enabled Workflow Integration
Integrate Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents and other model endpoints into enterprise workflows and applications.
Engineer the deterministic components around AI systems, including input validation, context retrieval, tool and function calling, business-rule enforcement, human approval, output handling and fallback paths.
Implement resilient orchestration for long-running or multi-step AI processes, with appropriate state management, timeout handling, compensation and human-in-the-loop controls.
Ensure sensitive data, prompts, model outputs and integration telemetry are handled in accordance with security, privacy and responsible AI requirements.

Observability, Reliability & Operational Excellence
Instrument integrations end to end using Application Insights, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry.
Implement distributed tracing, transaction correlation, correlation IDs, structured logging, metrics and actionable alerts across APIs, functions, queues, events and AI dependencies.
Design robust error-handling and resilience mechanisms, including retries with backoff and jitter, timeouts, circuit breakers, bulkheads, poison-message handling, dead-letter queues and replay procedures.
Define service-level indicators and operational dashboards covering availability, latency, throughput, error rate, queue depth, dependency health, cost and business transaction completion.
Perform production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across distributed systems, and produce runbooks that enable effective support and incident response.

Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD & Quality Engineering
Provision and configure integration services using Terraform and Bicep, with modular, reusable and environment-aware infrastructure definitions.
Build CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, incorporating code quality, security scanning, automated tests, deployment approvals and rollback strategies.
Implement unit, contract, integration, end-to-end, performance, resilience and failure-mode testing for APIs, workflows and event-driven components.
Use source control, peer review, branching and release-management practices appropriate to enterprise delivery.
Optimise solutions for scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance and cloud cost.

Agile Delivery, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Work with Product Owners, Architects, Testers, Cloud Developers, AI Engineers and service teams to deliver product increments against agreed sprint goals.
Produce clear technical documentation covering APIs, events, message schemas, data flows, identity, deployment, observability, support and recovery procedures.
Create proofs of concept and technical spikes to validate patterns, while ensuring successful patterns can be hardened for production use.
Mentor colleagues, review technical work and contribute reusable accelerators, standards and lessons learned to the wider AI and application practice.

Required Experience
5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, systems integration, cloud application development or automation, including at least 2 years delivering cloud-native integrations in production.
Demonstrable experience developing end-to-end business process automations, rather than only configuring integration platforms or defining architectures.
Demonstrable hands-on delivery of APIs, serverless components, messaging solutions and event-driven architectures on Azure or AWS.
Experience operating distributed integrations in production, including troubleshooting, performance analysis, resilience engineering and support handover.
Experience working in Agile delivery teams and collaborating with architecture, security, test, data and operations functions.
Fluent Spanish and professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in an IT services, systems integrator, managed services or consulting environment.
Relevant certifications such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, AWS Developer or Solutions Architect, and HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
Experience with containers, Kubernetes, Dapr, Kafka or enterprise integration platforms is advantageous.

Working Conditions & Package

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React or ASP.NET Razor)
jobs.description:
Challenge yourself and us

At AdvanceWorks, we learn together, grow together, and have fun together. And we do all this while creating great software solutions for clients across many industries and geographies.
We are constantly challenging ourselves and each other to use the latest technologies and the best methodologies and make sure we walk the talk.

About the project

You will join a public digital healthcare programme for a client in one of the Nordic countries. The work focuses on digital solutions used in the public healthcare sector, including interfaces built for healthcare staff and clinical specialists in their daily clinical work.
Depending on the client's needs, you may work across several of the client's initiatives or on a specific project. In both cases, you will work with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders towards clearly defined objectives, as part of a wider effort to support digital transformation and the client's strategic goals in healthcare.
Accessibility, security, and data protection are central to the project. The solutions follow WCAG 2.2 A and AA, apply security-by-design principles to defend against the OWASP Top 10, and handle medical record information under strict data protection rules. The interfaces connect to documented REST APIs with OpenAPI definitions and run on cloud-native platforms built to scale horizontally.
On the frontend, the technology stack follows one of two routes: .NET 8+ with ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or React 18+ with strict TypeScript. Code quality is managed through a defined development handbook, and the team uses artificial intelligence in software development in a responsible and structured way.

What will be your role

We are looking for a Frontend Developer to build accessible, secure, and reliable interfaces for healthcare professionals in a public digital healthcare setting.
You will work either with .NET 8+ and ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or with React 18+ and strict TypeScript, depending on your background. Your work will turn clinical and business needs into interfaces that healthcare staff can rely on, with accessibility, security, and data protection built in from the start.
You will work closely with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders, connecting your interfaces to documented REST APIs and contributing to cloud-native solutions designed for horizontal scaling. You will also take ownership of defined work packages, deliverables, and decisions, and may act as a point of contact with stakeholders for the parts of the solution you lead.
The role is fully remote from Portugal, with occasional trips to the client once or twice a year. Experience with healthcare projects is especially valued, as it gives a strong understanding of the context these interfaces are built for.

Your responsibilities will include

Developing frontend interfaces for healthcare staff and clinical specialists.
Building and releasing solutions with .NET 8+ and ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or with React 18+ and strict TypeScript.
Applying strict TypeScript settings, including strict mode, noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks, and exactOptionalPropertyTypes, when working on the React route.
Implementing WCAG 2.2 A and AA accessibility requirements throughout project delivery.
Applying WAI-ARIA labelling and carrying out screen reader testing.
Integrating with documented REST APIs using JSON and OpenAPI definitions.
Using automatic code generation based on OpenAPI definitions.
Contributing to cloud-native solutions designed for horizontal scaling.
Applying resilience patterns such as retry and circuit-breaking.
Applying security-by-design principles and defending against OWASP Top 10 and CWE vulnerabilities.
Making sure information security and data protection requirements are met, including the handling of medical record information.
Ensuring code quality with the tools defined in the project's development handbook.
artificial intelligence in software development in a responsible and structured way.
Working with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders towards defined objectives.
Taking ownership of defined work packages, deliverables, and technical decisions.
Acting as a point of contact with stakeholders and leading improvements in your area of the solution.
Contributing to digital transformation initiatives and the client's strategic objectives in healthcare.

What should you bring to the team?

Postgraduate or specialist university-level education in computer science or software engineering
More than 3 years of combined experience with .NET 5+, including development and release with .NET 8 or later, plus experience with ASP.NET Razor (not WebForms) and/or HTMX; or
Experience with React 18+ in strict mode, along with experience in TypeScript v6+ and more than 2 years of combined experience with TypeScript v5+.
Experience with cloud-native solutions designed for horizontal scaling.
Knowledge of resilience patterns in cloud programming, such as retry and circuit-breaking.
Proven experience applying WCAG 2.2 A and AA in project delivery.
Experience with WAI-ARIA labelling and screen reader testing.
Experience with documented REST APIs using JSON, OpenAPI definitions on all endpoints, and automatic code generation.
Experience with security-oriented design and defences against the OWASP Top 10.
Knowledge of security-by-design principles and CWE.
Experience in information security and data protection.
Familiarity with the guidance issued by the Data Protection Authority on data protection and the handling of medical record information.
Knowledge of and experience with a commonly used code quality tool.
Experience building interfaces for healthcare staff or clinical specialists is valued.
Experience with healthcare projects is a strong advantage.
Experience working in cross-disciplinary teams with different team members and stakeholders towards defined objectives.
Experience taking or leading projects that supported digital transformation or strategic objectives
Ability to take responsibility for work packages, deliverables, or decisions, and to deliver results independently.
Experience leading part of a system or solution, guiding its direction, or acting as a point of contact with stakeholders.
Knowledge of and experience with the responsible and structured use of artificial intelligence in software development.
Authorisation to work in the European Economic Area.
Availability to work remotely from Portugal, with occasional trips to the client once or twice a year.

What is in it for you

An amazing informal culture of smart, hardworking, and friendly people who support and care about each other.
A mentorship program from day one.
The opportunity to work with real-world operational data from tolling and Intelligent Transportation Systems.
The opportunity to work on large-scale data and cloud projects using modern technologies.
Formal training and certifications in data, cloud, and engineering excellence.
Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies.
A dynamic company where your ideas matter more than job titles.
Flexibility with responsibility.
A Rubber Duck to help you debug those tricky data pipelines.

Als Fullstack Engineer
bist du Teil eines Teams, das für die Prozessautomatisierung von Festnetzzugangsprojekten innerhalb der Telekom Deutschland verantwortlich ist. Du arbeitest in einem innovativen und agilen Umfeld und implementierst zukunftsorientierte Softwarelösungen zur Verwaltung und Planung des Hardware-Rollouts für das Festnetzzugangsnetz. Das Fixed Access Rollout Orchestration (FARO) System ist eine Cloud-native Softwareplattform, deren Hauptaufgabe die Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen ist, basierend auf einer Microservice-Architektur, die in C# .NET geschrieben ist. Das Team wird Konnektoren für FARO entwickeln und für die Entwicklung von Templates und APIs für Camunda verantwortlich sein.

Hauptaufgaben

Design, Entwicklung und Wartung skalierbarer Backend-Microservices mit C# .NET in einer Kubernetes-orchestrierten Umgebung
Implementierung und Verbesserung der Nachverfolgbarkeit, Beobachtbarkeit und Stabilität der wachsenden Microservice-Architektur durch Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, Prometheus und Dapr
Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Frontend-Komponenten mit Angular zur Bereitstellung responsiver Benutzeroberflächen und Unterstützung schneller Feature-Deployments
Design und Implementierung von RESTful APIs und Integrationskonnektoren für FARO und die Camunda-Prozessautomatisierungsplattform
Modellierung, Konfiguration und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen unter Verwendung von BPMN-Standards im Camunda-Ökosystem
Containerisierung von Anwendungen mit Docker und Verwaltung von Deployment-Pipelines in Kubernetes-Clustern
Durchführung von Code-Reviews, Weitergabe von technischem Fachwissen und konstruktives Feedback während des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus zur Aufrechterhaltung der Code-Qualität und des Teamwachstums
Fehlerbehebung, Diagnose und Lösung von Performance-Engpässen und Systemproblemen in der Microservice-Architektur
Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Automatisierungsprozessen
Förderung von Innovation durch Evaluierung und Implementierung neuer Technologien und Best Practices in der Softwareentwicklung, einschließlich Design Patterns, Clean Code-Prinzipien und testgetriebener Entwicklung

Dein Profil

Wir suchen einen qualifizierten Fullstack Engineer
mit umfangreicher Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# .NET, fundierten Kenntnissen in Microservice-Architekturen, Containerisierungstechnologien und Prozessautomatisierungsplattformen, kombiniert mit solidem Bildungshintergrund und kollaborativer Denkweise.

Muss-Kriterien

Abschluss in Informatik, Computer Science oder einem verwandten Bereich
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Fullstack- oder Backend-Entwickler
Kenntnisse in mindestens einer objektorientierten Programmiersprache, vorzugsweise C#
Praktische Erfahrung mit Containerisierung mittels Docker
Praktische Erfahrung mit Orchestrierung mittels Kubernetes
Praktische Erfahrung mit Camunda
Kenntnisse in BPMN-Prozessmodellierung
Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Entwicklung von Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, Prometheus und Dapr
Vertraut mit gängigen Best Practices der Softwareentwicklung einschließlich Design Patterns
Vertraut mit Clean-Code-Prinzipien
Vertraut mit testgetriebener Entwicklung (TDD)
Vertraut mit Versionskontrollsystemen (Git)
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microservice-Architekturen, vorzugsweise mit .NET und Kubernetes
Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von RESTful APIs
Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von Integration Connectors
Analytische und lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise an Problemstellungen
Angetrieben von der Bereitschaft zu wachsen und dich und dein Team kontinuierlich dazu zu bringen, innovative Ideen zu erkunden
Fähigkeit, in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld erfolgreich zu sein
Begeisterung für kollaborative Entwicklungspraktiken
Interesse an Telekommunikationstechnologien und deren Anwendungen
Gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil

Deutschkenntnisse
Erfahrung mit Angular und die Fähigkeit, schnelle und effektive Anpassungen am Frontend vorzunehmen
Praktische Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Automatisierungsprozessen
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Performance-Optimierung und Troubleshooting komplexer Systemprobleme
Vertrautheit mit aufkommenden Technologien und Best Practices in der Softwareentwicklung
Begeisterung dafür, aufkommende Technologien und Best Practices zu evaluieren und zu implementieren

Als attraktivster Arbeitgeber Ungarns im Jahr 2025 (laut repräsentativer Umfrage von Randstad) ist Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
eine Tochtergesellschaft der Deutsche Telekom Gruppe. Das Unternehmen bietet mit mehr als 5300 Mitarbeitern ein breites Portfolio an IT- und Telekommunikationsdienstleistungen. Wir haben Hunderte von Großkunden und Konzernen in Deutschland und anderen europäischen Ländern.

DT-ITS erhielt 2019 den Best in Educational Cooperation Award von HIPA

Mid-level experience — comfortable owning a live customer issue independently.

new_jobs.description:
Dataplatforms veranderen continu, maar hoe voorkom je dat deze wijzigingen zorgen voor downtime of verstoorde rapportages? In deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe je aanpassingen aan datastructuren en -modellen slim kunt doorvoeren zónder de beschikbaarheid van data te onderbreken. Je ontwikkelt en test een strategie waarmee je laat zien dat stabiele, toekomstbestendige deployments ook in dynamische Azure-omgevingen mogelijk zijn.

In een wereld waarin data essentieel is voor besluitvorming is de betrouwbaarheid en continuïteit van een dataplatform van cruciaal belang. Zeker in organisaties die actief dataplatforms beheren en optimaliseren in de Azure Cloud, zijn wijzigingen aan datastructuren en -modellen onvermijdelijk. Ze sluiten aan op nieuwe inzichten en veranderende bedrijfsbehoeften.

Een nadeel is dat veel dataplatforms bij zulke wijzigingen minder beschikbaar zijn, bijvoorbeeld door onderhoud of deployments waarbij onderdelen opnieuw geladen moeten worden. Dit leidt tot onderbrekingen in rapportages en analyses. Hoe kun je dergelijke wijzigingen doorvoeren zonder downtime of verlies van beschikbaarheid? En welke ontwerpkeuzes maken dat mogelijk? Dit is een herkenbare uitdaging voor veel organisaties die werken met grote hoeveelheden data en continue beschikbaarheid vereisen.

De opdracht

Onderzoek hoe wijzigingen aan datastructuren en -modellen binnen SQL Server(less) databases en Analysis Services-omgevingen in Azure Cloud zó uitgerold kunnen worden dat de beschikbaarheid van data behouden blijft. Ontwerp en evalueer hiervoor een strategie of patroon, bijvoorbeeld via een Blue-Green deployment, feature toggles of gescheiden laagringen. Werk dit uit in een Proof of Concept (PoC) binnen Azure DevOps waarmee je laat zien dat downtimevrije deployments haalbaar zijn.

new_jobs.description:
Mode of Employment:
Fixed Term / 20 hours / week

Shape the future of autonomous industrial ecosystems as a Working Student (f/m/d) for Federated Software Architectures in Erlangen or Garching – become part of our pioneering research team and turn visionary ideas into hands-on, innovative solutions. Ready to challenge boundaries and make software smarter together?

Connect, learn, and grow with our Working Student Network – your space to exchange ideas, build meaningful relationships, and navigate your Siemens journey.

You'll make an impact by

You support our research team in developing and evolving federated software architectures that operate reliably across distributed, independently evolving systems
Building on this, you prototype with innovative concepts like Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), agent-based workflows, and intelligent data processing to enable seamless coordination without central control
In close collaboration with colleagues, you help translate research ideas into tangible use cases and implement them as clean, well-structured software solutions
You contribute your own ideas and actively participate in discussions, always seeking ways to push technical boundaries and drive our projects forward
Throughout, you regularly exchange with your mentor and team, balancing on-site meetings with flexible remote work options

This Is How You'll Win Us Over

Education: You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with a focus on software architecture, distributed systems, or AI engineering
Experience and Skills:
You possess solid skills in at least one programming language such as Java, Go, .NET, Python, or TypeScript, ideally with frameworks like Spring or React
Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message brokers (Kafka, NATS), containerization (Docker), or LLM-based frameworks is a plus
You are familiar with modern software development tools and AI-assisted workflows such as GitHub Copilot

Ways of Working: You enjoy collaborating in a team, take initiative, communicate openly, and are motivated to learn and experiment with new technologies
Languages: You are fluent in English; German skills are an advantage but not required

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About Us

The world never stands still. And new challenges arise every day. With a passion for questioning things, for supplying ideas, and intelligently driving things forward we are helping society move towards a smarter tomorrow. Be it with technologies that reduce carbon emissions in cities or hyperintelligent robots. This is how we are able, to tackle the most important projects and push them forward together. Help us shape the future.

Du bist interessiert an der Stelle als Fullstack-Developer (m/w/d) für C# & Angular bei OCCON GmbH
?

Auf Instaffo kannst du dich für diesen und weitere Jobs ohne großen Aufwand bewerben. Erstelle dein Profil in unter 2 Minuten und starte den Bewerbungsprozess mit nur wenigen Klicks.

Anforderungen

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für die DACH-Region
erforderlich ist.

Sprache: Deutsch - Fließend (C1), Englisch - Fließend (C1)

Min. 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit C#
Ideal sind Kenntnisse in Frameworks, wie zB. Angular, VueJS oder React
Interesse oder erste Erfahrungen mit nicht- relationalen Datenbanken, wie zB. Apache Cassandra, MongoDB und Neo4j
Eigenständige, strukturierte und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise, hohes persönliches Engagement, Teamplayer

Tätigkeiten

Du wirst in den gesamten Projektablauf von Konzeption über Implementierung, Dokumentation und Veröffentlichung neuer Module für unsere In-House-Web-Anwendung. Bei dem nötigen Know-How helfen wir natürlich. Für deine Arbeit wirst du Erfahrung in C#, Angular, Git (Github, Devops) und Linux sammeln können.
Zusammen mit dem gesamten Team, kümmerst du dich um die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Datenbanken, Backups und Updates unserer internen Systeme.
Hinterlasse deine persönliche Note indem du eine Ideen einbringst und vorantreibst.

Team

Du bereicherst ein Team aus 3 Entwicklern, der Head of IT Lucas ist seit 10 Jahren dabei; gemeinsam begleiten wir große Kunden und deren Projekte, wie z. B. BIC, Duavit oder Kunden aus der Automobilbranche.

Über das Unternehmen

Was wir tun

Wir unterstützen Unternehmen im Bereich der Transportbeschaffung. Dazu gehören nicht nur der Einkauf, sondern auch Planung, Controlling und Marktstudien. Wir beraten unsere Kunden, unterstützen sie bei fehlenden Kapazitäten und stellen ihnen praxiserprobte Anwendungen zur Verfügung.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes und unabhängiges Beratungs- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen für alle Verkehrsträger mit Sitz in Ludwigshafen, das sowohl Fachwissen in der Transportlogistik als auch IT-Know-how in sich vereint.

Für wen wir arbeiten

Mit Sitz im Zentrum der EU arbeiten wir für weltweit tätige Konzerne. Wir unterstützen Produktions- und Handelsunternehmen aus verschiedenen Branchen wie Automobil, Chemie, Konsumgüter und Pharma.

Unsere Werte

Wir sind reaktionsschnell. Unser Anspruch ist es, unsere Kunden gerade dann zu unterstützen, wenn es hart auf hart kommt. Wir legen Wert auf direkte Kommunikation mit unseren Kunden und innerhalb unseres Teams. Auf diese Weise realisieren wir flexible, individuelle Lösungen und effiziente Markteinführungszeiten.

Klicke auf "Bewerben" für Details zu den Benefits, dem Team und dem Bewerbungsprozess.

new_jobs.title: SAP Senior Consultant & Architect (m/w/d/x)
new_jobs.description:
T-Systems International GmbH

Bei T-Systems bieten wir unseren Geschäftskunden die richtigen Systemlösungen für ihr digitales Business. Mit unserem Portfolio stellen wir sicher, dass digitale Transformation Komplexität reduziert, Kosten einspart und die alltägliche Arbeit erleichtert. Unsere Schwerpunkte sind Konnektivität, Digital, Cloud & Infrastruktur sowie Sicherheit - Let's power higher performance!

Aufgaben

Als SAP Senior Consultant & Architect (m/w/d/x)
übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Gestaltung komplexer SAP-Zielarchitekturen und begleiten unsere Kunden von der strategischen Beratung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.

Sie entwickeln SAP-Lösungen in Einsatzbereichen Finance, Logistik und/oder HCM. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt in der Konzeption und Steuerung der Umsetzung insbesondere für S/4HANA-Transformationen, H4S4-Einführungen sowie Integrations- und Schnittstellen-Architekturen. Dabei verstehen Sie die Geschäftsprozesse, bringen hervorragende technische Kenntnisse ein und schaffen einen guten Ausgleich zwischen SAP-Standards und notwendigen Individual-Entwicklungen. Sie sind mit heterogenen Systemlandschaften als Basis für Ihre Lösungen vertraut. Sie nutzen die SAP BTP als Grundlage für Integration, Erweiterung, Automatisierung und KI-nahe Szenarien im Kontext moderner SAP-Architekturen und der SAP Business AI Platform.

Ihre Aufgabe
in Projekten beinhaltet insbesondere:

Sie beraten unsere Kunden als Trusted Advisor, erstellen Konzepte für (Groß-)Projekte und übernehmen die Präsentation vor den entscheidenden Stakeholdern
Sie entwickeln und detaillieren SAP-Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung von relevanten Geschäftsprozessen, Schnittstellen, Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und Optimierung
Sie übernehmen die fachliche Steuerung, unterstützen damit unsere Projektleitung, und leisten einen relevanten Beitrag zum technischen und fachlichen Kompetenz-Ausbau des Projektteams, auch in Verbindung mit dem Einsatz neuer Technologien wie KI
Sie stellen sicher, dass Methoden, technische Strategien, Regelwerke, Standards, Sicherheitsaspekte und Best Practices berücksichtigt werden
Sie identifizieren fachliche Erweiterungspotenziale beim Kunden und wirken in Bid-Teams bei fachlichen Konzeptionen, Präsentationen und bei der Qualitätssicherung von Angeboten mit

Profil

Sie verfügen über ein Studium in den Fachrichtungen (Wirtschafts-) Informatik oder in verwandten Fachrichtungen, bevorzugt mit einem Masterabschluss oder Diplom und bringen mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung als SAP-Kundenberater und SAP-(Software)-Architekt mit.

Ihre spezifischen Kenntnisse:

Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen in ausgewählten Industrien (besonders Public, Health, Defense, Automotive, produzierender Mittelstand) am deutschsprachigen Markt (D-A-CH)
Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen und Technologiekenntnisse über den SAP-Bereich hinaus (Digitalisierungs-Themen und aktuelle Technologie-Trends am Markt)
Aktuelle SAP-Zertifizierungen in den genannten Themenfeldern und in allgemeinen Architektur-Methoden
Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch und Englisch (jeweils verhandlungssicher, mind. C1)

Diese Stelle ist auch in Teilzeit möglich.

new_jobs.title: (Senior) Manager AI Engineering (all genders)
new_jobs.description:
Aufgaben

Du begeisterst dich für innovative Technologien und Generative AI? Du möchtest nicht nur Architekturen entwerfen, sondern KI-Lösungen produktiv machen, skalierbare Systeme bauen und Kunden bei der Integration moderner AI unterstützen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von KI-gestützten Architekturen, Anwendungen und Workflows.

Dabei warten die folgenden Aufgaben auf dich:

Technische Verantwortung: Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer AI-, GenAI- und Agentic-AI-Lösungen für nationale und internationale Kunden.
Solution Architecture: Entwicklung skalierbarer AI-Architekturen sowie Integration von AI-Modellen in bestehende Engineering- und IT-Landschaften.
Engineering Use Cases: Automatisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen entlang des Produktentwicklungszyklus mit Fokus auf CAD, Requirements Engineering und Simulations.
Technische Beratung: Aufnahme und Bewertung fachlicher Anforderungen sowie Übersetzung komplexer Herausforderungen in nachhaltige AI-Lösungen.
Projektverantwortung: Steuerung anspruchsvoller AI-Projekte über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg, von der Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
Fachliche Führung: Coaching und Mentoring von Consultants, Engineers und Projektteams sowie Förderung technologischer Best Practices.
Innovation & Technologieentwicklung: Bewertung neuer AI-Technologien, AI Security, Entwicklung von Prototypen und Weiterentwicklung unseres Leistungsportfolios im Bereich AI Engineering.

Anforderungen

Um für deinen Weg gewappnet zu sein, hast du folgende Qualifikationen im Gepäck:

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Software Engineering, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit mindestens 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung im Consulting- und (Gen)AI-Umfeld
Leidenschaft für AI & Generative AI, skalierbare Systeme, Cloud-Technologien und den Aufbau performanter AI-Infrastrukturen
Expertise in Python, ML, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Cloud-Umgebungen (Azure, AWS, GCP), Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, CI/CD sowie modernen AI-Architekturen.
Kenntnisse in der Projektleitung, Softwarearchitektur, Cloud-native Design, MLOps und AI Security
Deine Arbeitsweise ist geprägt von technischer Exzellenz, Eigenverantwortung, strategischem Denken, Teamorientierung und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität.

Wissenswertes vor der Abfahrt:

Beginn:
nach Vereinbarung – immer zu Beginn eines Monats

in Vollzeit (40h) und/oder Teilzeit möglich; 30 Urlaubstage

new_jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer
new_jobs.description:
Summary

We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join a cross-functional agile team committed to building the core architecture and infrastructure of our next-generation platform.

This is not just another feature team role. You will be contributing to the foundation of a scalable, cloud-ready system, designed to operate across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.

You'll work in a modern engineering ecosystem, using technologies such as .NET Core, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, and Ably, as well as evolving current .NET Framework solutions.

Please note:
This role follows a hybrid working model and requires onsite attendance at our Kraków office three days per week.

What You'll Do
Designing and developing scalable microservices from the ground up
Implementing according to architectural and product design documents
Reverse engineering of current business logic modules
Modernizing legacy components to meet new business requirements
Writing clean, maintainable code with a strong focus on quality and testability (TDD)
Participating in code reviews and driving engineering guidelines
Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across product, QA, and DevOps
Building and maintaining the team's AI tooling — reusable skills, custom agents, MCP servers, and repo instruction files that encode how our platform actually works

What We're Looking For
6+ years of experience in backend development using .NET / .NET Core
Hands-on experience building large-scale web-based systems
Solid understanding of microservices architecture
Good knowledge of relational databases
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently while being a reliable teammate
Continuous learning approach and adaptability to new technologies
Good written and verbal English communication skills

AI-first engineering (we mean this literally)

Our codebase is too large to hold in your head, so we work with AI agents by default, and we invest in the tooling that makes them accurate here.

We're looking for someone who: Uses agentic coding tools daily for real production work — not autocomplete, but delegating multi-step tasks and reviewing the output critically
Has authored reusable agent tooling: skills, custom subagents, slash commands, MCP servers, hooks, or equivalent — and can talk about what made them work or fail

new_jobs.description:
EBS is a rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial technology company and part of Alarm.com. Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6+ million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. We’re innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more.

The Access Control (AC) team
is a blend of full-stack engineers, leaning backend, who build the platform that businesses rely on to secure and manage physical access to their properties. Our services span the full journey of an access control system — from cloud APIs and event pipelines down to the communication layer that talks directly to panels, card readers, and smart locks in the field. Some examples include enabling multi-site businesses to manage access from a single dashboard, delivering real-time access activity and history to property managers, and keeping thousands of controllers in the field configured, updated, and in sync with the cloud. We’re seeking a Software Engineer II
(Backend-leaning Full-stack) who is passionate about building reliable, scalable systems that bridge cloud software and real-world hardware and wants to see their code open doors — literally — for businesses around the world.

As a Software Engineer II on the Access Control team, you will design, develop, and maintain the backend services that power our access control platform — from cloud APIs and event pipelines down to the systems that communicate with physical controllers and readers in the field. While the role is backend-leaning, you’ll work across the full stack, contributing to our web front end when features call for it. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers who will support your growth as you take on increasing ownership of features and systems.

Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. We are building a new team in Krakow. Our employees work fully from the office with possibility to work remotely occasionally.

Responsibilities

Build and Deliver: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and data models that power our access control platform.
Bridge Cloud and Hardware: Contribute to the device communication layer that connects our cloud platform to access control hardware — panels, readers, and locks — including device configuration, firmware update, and real-time event processing flows.
Contribute Across Layers: Develop features across the full stack, including web front-end features (Ember.js), when projects require it.
Own the Lifecycle: Take part in the entire development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and production monitoring.
Get Hands-On: Work directly with real access control hardware to develop, test, and debug device integrations.
Ensure Quality: Write unit and integration tests, validate features before release, and monitor production performance.
Balance Trade-offs: Exercise good judgment — know when to iterate quickly and when to build for scale, robustness, and maintainability.
Collaborate: Work closely with product managers, hardware/device engineers, and other software teams across time zones.
Grow and Share: Learn from senior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing — and share your own knowledge as the team grows.
Continuous Improvement: Bring your ideas! We want our engineers to collaborate on product development, not blindly build to a spec.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong object-oriented programming skills; experience with C# is a plus.
Experience developing backend services and HTTP APIs (REST or similar).
Experience with database design and development (SQL).
Experience with creating and maintaining unit tests; familiarity with integration testing and CI/CD is a plus.
Familiarity with a modern JavaScript framework such as Ember.js, Angular, or React.
Experience working with hardware, IoT, or device development is a plus.
Good communication skills.

Why Work for Alarm.com?

Make an immediate impact — own projects that directly affect the businesses that rely on our security solutions every day.
Work with real-world IoT devices — see your code in action on the access control panels, readers, and locks we integrate with.
Be empowered — take ownership of features, drive technical decisions, and build best-in-class products.
Work with modern technologies — our stack includes C#, .NET, SQL Server, Kafka, Ember.js, and native mobile applications.
Long-term employment based on a permanent employment contract (CoE).
Attractive benefits package — Medical care, life insurance, sports package, annual budget for professional development ($2,000).

Company Info

Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6 million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. And every day, we're innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more. We're seeking those who are passionate about creating change through technology and who want to make a lasting impact on the world around them.

EBS Sp. z o.o. is a dynamically growing Polish technology company, combining decades of innovation with deep expertise in smart security solutions. We are part of the American corporation Alarm.com, a leading global provider of intelligent security solutions for homes and businesses.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com or ebssmart.com

Are you looking to grow not only as a software developer, but also as a trusted advisor? At Columbia Road, we're looking for talented developers to help businesses grow while you grow your career. If you've already gained some hands-on experience in professional software development and are eager to grow into a skilled consultant in a low-hierarchy, supportive environment, we would love to hear from you. Let’s find your Road!

TLDR

Role: Software Developer (Associate Consultant or Consultant)
Focus: Help businesses grow by building and improving digital sales channels and systems for our clients.
Environment: Low-hierarchy, supportive, community-led, with an emphasis on transparency and trust.
Team: Varying teams built around each individual client’s need. Cross-competence collaboration.
Ideal Candidate: A couple years of professional web development (full-stack) experience, eager to learn and make an impact. The position is also suitable for someone finishing their studies. Fluent in English and Finnish.
Location: Helsinki or Tampere, no visa sponsorships offered.
Salary & benefits: Monthly gross salary 3000-4500€, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. Extensive benefits package, including e.g. comprehensive healthcare insurance, allowance for sports/massage/commuting and compensation for doing social good & open source projects to name a few.

Who we are

Columbia Road is the go-to consulting partner for businesses that want to sell better. Excelling in both commercial operations and scalable technology, we build seamless and effective customer journeys for measurable impact. In each of our projects, we focus on generating more revenue and more customers for our clients, working in cross-competence teams made up of the brightest minds in digital commerce.

As a community-led company, we believe in giving a lot of responsibility and freedom to our employees. Instead of line managers and red tape, we offer the tools and resources to all Roadies to make the best possible decisions for their own job and for our community. We offer you a diverse and inclusive workplace, and your fellow Roadies will ensure that you’ll feel comfortable from day one.

The job & what you’d be working on

As a software developer, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern digital sales channels. You’ll get to work together with other Columbia Road consultants in a cross-competence team, building and growing new digital businesses for our customers in various fields of business. This means you may collaborate daily with designers, digital marketers, strategy consultants, data & AI specialists as well as our clients' stakeholders and team. You will be supported in your learning by peers in both development and other domains, and you’ll have the ability to create real impact in our clients’ businesses.

Your motivation comes from the results and impact your solution creates, rather than the technical beauty of the code. For us, technology is a tool to create business impact for our clients, and we are agnostic in choosing whichever tools best solve the challenge. This can mean widely used programming languages and frameworks, but also different CRM, CMS and ecommerce solutions that we customise and integrate to our clients’ other systems. We have listed some examples further below.

If you're looking for a workplace where you get a lot of responsibility and where you get to learn new things fast from more experienced peers, you'll find it here. You will get to grow with us, nurture your own ambitions and learn new skills within digital sales.

This position is a great fit for you if

You are a student in the final year of your studies, or have graduated within the past couple of years.
You have already gained professional work experience related to software development. For example, you may have worked part time in a professional setting during your studies.
You have a good understanding of the basic principles of both backend and frontend software development.
You’re agnostic in your tech-approach and are open to using a wide array of languages, frameworks, CRM and CMS systems and ecommerce platforms, selecting the tools that best match our clients’ needs.
Some of the most common languages we come across in our work are JavaScript, Typescript, PHP, Java and C#. We hope you are comfortable with more than one of these.
Other technologies seen as an advantage include: Clojure, Scala, Python, Go as well as any experience working with CMS, CRM and ecommerce platforms.
You are self-driven, proactive and want to continuously learn new things.
You understand the basics of digitalisation and you approach problems in an analytical manner.
You would love to work with challenging client cases supported by a diverse community of digital sales professionals.
You are comfortable communicating matters related to your own work and you enjoy working with other people in an agile environment – it’s not a problem for you to present your own ideas to a small group of people from time to time, for example in a workshop.
You have a “get things done” attitude towards your work.
You live (or plan to move) within commuting distance of Helsinki or Tampere and are open to working on-site according to client needs.
You are fluent in English and Finnish.

Our recruitment process typically involves 2-3 interviews where we learn about your skills and what motivates you. You'll discover more about Columbia Road and meet various Roadies along the way. After our discussions, we'll reach out to your chosen references.
This is a permanent, full-time position with a flexible start date from August 2026. We hope to hear from you soon!

new_jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
new_jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Je bent een ambitieuze developer die kwaliteit levert. Je leert snel vanwege je diepgaande interesse in IT, staat met beide benen op de grond en kunt goed samenwerken. Je bijt je graag vast in complexe vraagstukken, zodat jij de beste oplossing kan bieden aan de klant.

Verder heb jij:

een afgeronde professionele bachelor applicatieontwikkeling;
een passie voor softwareontwikkeling;
ambitie om je te ontwikkelen tot een ware vakman;
een brede interesse in het Java of .NET-platform;
maximaal 2 jaar werkervaring als softwareontwikkelaar.

Wat biedt Info Support jou?

Uiteraard bieden we je een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden met verschillende keuzemogelijkheden. Denk hierbij aan:

Vakantiegeld, winstuitkering, onkostenvergoeding, bijdrage pensioen, hospitalisatieverzekering, maaltijdcheques
Leasebudget met tankpas (ook voor het buitenland)
Fietsleaseplan
Laptop en smartphone (of BYOD), facilitering thuiswerkplek
Een startsalaris vanaf €2.900 bruto, op basis van 40 uur. En een transparant salaris- en beloningsbeleid

Het eerste jaar van je IT-carrière bij Info Support, kan je bij Info Support in Nederland werken. Kies je daarvoor? Dan regelen wij jouw huisvesting!

Gedurende de eerste twee jaar van je dienstverband volg je onder werktijd naast vakinhoudelijke cursussen en opleidingen regelmatig sociale, bedrijfskundige en commerciële trainingen. Na die twee jaar kan je daardoor eventueel al doorgroeien naar andere rollen.

Ook na de eerste twee jaar krijgt je alle ruimte om je nog verder te ontwikkelen en je doelen en ambities waar te maken. Daar helpen we je bij door samen met jou een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan op te stellen waarin jij op inhoudelijk én persoonlijk vlak nog verder kunt groeien.

Daarnaast biedt Info Support jou:

Collegiale en gepassioneerde IT-collega’s die je continu uitdagen en verder brengen

Leuke team-, unit- en bedrijfsuitjes en de mogelijkheid om je aan te sluiten bij de kook-, boeken-, gaming-, cycle-, muziek- of (mud)runclub of een nieuwe club te starten
Werken bij een solide groeiende en financieel gezonde werkgever!

Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare.
